title: Head Coach Developer - Women's Coaching Pathway
description:
About the Programme

Bloomsbury Football Foundation is on a mission to transform lives through the magic of football. Bloomsbury’s Women’s Coaching Pathway is built on the belief that every girl and woman in football deserves the chance to see herself reflected in a role model. This programme to build a real route from loving the game to making an impact in the local community at grassroots level.

We impact 7,000 young people a week, with community coaching at the centre of our approach. To us, a coach is a trusted adult, someone their players can rely on, helping them reach their full potential. This pathway has been created to ensure the cohort leaves feeling confident to coach any child, regardless of their ability or background.


Kicking off in early 2027, this one-of-a-kind programme delivers a mix of on-pitch and off-pitch learning, bringing coaches together with a trailblazing group of mentors and coach developers who’ve shaped the game themselves.


Because football, and the young people we coach, need more women leading from the sidelines.

About the role

As Head Coach Developer, you'll own how the programme runs. You'll work alongside our Head of Coaching to shape the curriculum, the six on pitch and off pitch CPD sessions, utilising the support of mentors as part of the cohort.

You'll design and deliver the CPD sessions, run workshops, and lead delivery from Kick Off Day through to final whistle. You'll be on the grass enough to know how everyone's progressing, and honest enough to help them grow through feedback, right through to handover into our hiring process.

This is a consultancy role with real scope to shape how the programme runs in its first year. It's a great fit for an experienced coach developer or coach educator who cares about community and grassroots football and wants to build something from scratch.

This role needs someone who can hold a high bar and a warm room at the same time. The best candidate has developed coaches before, knows the realities of grassroots delivery in London, and is motivated by seeing someone else get better rather than by coaching herself.

Key Responsibilities

Design & Deliver the CPD Programme
  • Work with our Head of Coaching to build the full curriculum of the Women’s Coach development pathway, including on and off pitch CPDs, clear milestones and development criteria
  • Keep the content rooted in skills to deliver to mixed abilities and mixed ages, ensuring engagement and fun is of the highest importance
  • Deliver these sessions to the cohort of aspiring community coaches
  • Support with planning and execution of key moments within the programme calendar, such as Kick Off event and CPDs
  • Arrange shadowing opportunities across our sessions so participants learn by doing, not just by listening
Build the Support Network
  • Assist the Head of Talent in the recruitment of mentors, using your own network to bring in excellent coach developers
  • Pair mentors with participants, supervise and manage pairing of programme participants to mentors
  • Be the first point of contact for mentors and participants and keep the Head of Coaching informed on progress throughout
Quality, Safeguarding and Progression
  • Track session observations and hold a clear, current picture of how each participant is developing and support participants at risk of falling short
  • Manage graduation and the handover into our hiring process for contract and full-time coaching roles
  • Gather feedback from the cohort and mentors, adapt the programme as it runs, and always uphold BFF's safeguarding policies and values
  • Work alongside the Programme Organiser to ensure sharp delivery and high-quality, BFF-aligned programming
Essential Criteria
  • Has a strong understanding of the barriers women face in football
  • A recognised coaching qualification, UEFA B or above (UEFA A desirable)
  • A track record designing coach development curriculum and mentoring or developing coaches directly
  • Experience coaching in community settings beyond club or academy football, such as breakfast clubs, holiday camps, and sessions covering a range of ages and genders
  • A good understanding of the grassroots and community football landscape, including the challenges facing women in coaching
  • Comfortable owning delivery end to end as a consultant, working independently and reporting into a small team
  • The organisational skills to plan and run a CPD programme from scratch
  • Excellent communication skills with coaches, mentors, families and partner organisations
  • Confident and up to date on safeguarding in youth sport, with an enhanced DBS (or willingness to obtain one)
  • Able to travel across to London twice a month and work Saturdays in line with the delivery calendar
  • Eligibility to live and work in the UK

About BSC The Barcelona Supercomputing Center - Centro Nacional de Supercomputación (BSC-CNS) is the leading supercomputing center in Spain.

It houses MareNostrum, one of the most powerful supercomputers in Europe, was a founding and hosting member of the former European HPC infrastructure PRACE (Partnership for Advanced Computing in Europe), and is now hosting entity for EuroHPC JU, the Joint Undertaking that leads large-scale investments and HPC provision in Europe.

The mission of BSC is to research, develop and manage information technologies in order to facilitate scientific progress.

BSC combines HPC service provision and R&D into both computer and computational science (life, earth and engineering sciences) under one roof, and currently has over **** staff from 60 countries.

Look At The BSC ExperienceBSC-CNS YouTube ChannelWe are particularly interested for this role in the strengths and lived experiences of women and underrepresented groups to help us avoid perpetuating biases and oversights in science and IT research.

In instances of equal merit, the incorporation of the under-represented sex will be favoured.

We promote Equity, Diversity and Inclusion, fostering an environment where each and every one of us is appreciated for who we are, regardless of our differences.

If you consider that you do not meet all the requirements, we encourage you to continue applying for the job offer.

We value diversity of experiences and skills, and you could bring unique perspectives to our team.

Context And MissionWe are looking for a Mid-Level Full Stack Developer with experience in .NET to join an internal platform used for time tracking and reporting in audit processes.

The selected candidate will be responsible for maintaining, improving, and supporting the application.

Key Duties Develop end-to-end features using .NET Core / .NET 6+ on the backend and Razor Views + HTML on the frontend Participate in architecture design and technical decision-making Contribute to code quality improvements, code reviews, and best practices Integrate REST APIs and work with SQL databases Provide support to the financial justification team regarding the platform.

Requirements EducationDegree in Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or similar

Essential Knowledge and Professional Experience 2–4 years of experience with C# and .NET Core / .NET 6+ Experience with Entity Framework and SQL Server Experience working with Razor Views Strong knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery Experience with web deployment (Kestrel/HTTPS) and SMTP/authentication setup Working fluency in Spanish and English is required, Catalan will be a plus.

Additional Knowledge and Professional Experience Understanding of REST APIs Nice to have: ASP.NET Identity Quartz.NET for scheduled jobs QuestPDF or similar PDF generation libraries EPPlus for Excel/CSV exports SMTP / automated email sending Serilog

Competences Autonomy & Proactivity: Ability to work independently and take initiative in development tasks. Technical Ownership: End-to-end responsibility for development, testing, and maintenance. Problem Solving: Diagnose and resolve issues. Clean Code & Best Practices: Experience with .NET best practices, design patterns, and Git. Communication & Collaboration: Clear communication with technical and non-technical staff.

Conditions The position will be located at BSC within the Management Department We offer a full-time contract (35h/week), a good working environment, a highly stimulating environment with state-of-the-art infrastructure, flexible working hours, extensive training plan, restaurant tickets, private health insurance, support to the relocation procedures Duration: Open-ended contract due to technical and scientific activities linked to the project and budget duration Holidays: 22 days of holidays + 6 personal days + 24th and 31st of December per our collective agreement Salary: we offer a competitive salary commensurate with the qualifications and experience of the candidate and according to the cost of living in Barcelona Starting date: ASAP

title: UZ Brussel - Medior / Senior Software Engineer Java
description:
UZ brussel: samen sterk in zorg, innovatie en wetenschap
Word onze nieuwe software engineer op de ICT dienst
UZ Brussel is een toonaangevend universitair ziekenhuis in het hart van onze hoofdstad. Wij zijn een warm en vooruitstrevend ziekenhuis waar innovatie, onderzoek en patiëntgerichte zorg hand in hand gaan. Elke dag zetten bijna 5.000 medewerkers zich in om onze missie waar te maken: zorg bieden die niet alleen uitblinkt in kwaliteit, maar ook in menselijkheid.
Wil jij met jouw talent het verschil maken voor onze patiënten? Dan ben jij de collega die we zoeken! Voor de ICT dienst zoeken we een gedreven Software Engineer die samen met ons de zorg naar een hoger niveau tilt. Maak deel uit van ons team en bouw mee aan zorg die inspireert!

Heb je interesse in onze technische omgeving?

  • Als Java Software Engineer werk je in een groot team aan de verdere uitbouw van Primuz, het Elektronisch Patiënten Dossier van het UZ Brussel.
  • Primuz wordt door zorgverleners gebruikt om medische en administratieve gegevens van patiënten te registreren en te raadplegen, en is essentieel in het zorgproces.
  • Onze technische omgeving is gebaseerd op marktstandaarden zoals OO design, Design Patterns en Java. Primuz bestaat uit een multi-tier Java applicatie met een Swing desktop client en een JEE applicatieserver.
  • Het developmentteam volgt Agile principes om continu nieuwe functionaliteit toe te voegen aan Primuz.

Interesse?

Ben jij die gedreven Software Engineer die een verschil wil maken op onze ICT dienst? Aarzel niet langer en solliciteer nu via de onderstaande link. Als Software Engineer op de ICT dienst draag jij niet alleen bij tot kwaliteitsvolle dienstverlening, maar ook aan de warme, persoonlijke benadering waar UZ Brussel bekend om staat.

Wat ga je doen
  • Je analyseert de behoeften van de gebruikers.
  • Je ontwikkelt kwalitatief goede Java code.
  • Je werkt mee aan de implementatie van nieuwe functionaliteiten en aan de implementatie van en interfacing met externe pakketten.
  • Je test de opgeleverde code en documenteert dit proces.
  • Je zorgt voor de nodige kennisoverdracht, zowel naar je collega's als naar de eindgebruikers.
  • Je staat in voor de continue opvolging en het beheer van de ontwikkelde software

Welke collega zoeken we?

We zijn op zoek naar een enthousiaste Software Engineerdie zichzelf herkent in volgende eigenschappen
  • Passie voor Software: je beschikt over een master- of bachelordiploma in ICT gerelateerde richting, liefst gecombineerd met enige ervaring in een gelijkaardige functie, maar dit is geen vereiste.
  • Taalvaardig:Nederlands is de voertaal binnen UZ Brussel, en het is belangrijk dat je deze taal vlot beheerst. Daarnaast heb je ook een goede kennis van het Engels.
  • Ervaring: je hebt minstens 3 jaar ervaring in Java development.
  • Tools: je hebt kennis van J2EE, Hibernate, Java Swing en/of Vaadin. Daarnaast klinken IntelliJ, Maven en Hudson je vertrouwd.
  • Kennis: je bent bovendien vertrouwd met databases, datamodellen en SQL.
  • Teamplayer: je bent bereid om binnen een team verantwoordelijkheid op te nemen voor de taken en projecten die aan jou werden toevertrouwd.

title: Senior DevOps / SRE / Platform Engineer — GCP & AI | 100% On-site Barcelona
description:
We are looking for a Senior DevOps / SRE / Platform Engineer with strong hands-on experience designing, automating and operating production infrastructure.


Se anima a todos los posibles solicitantes a que se desplacen y lean la descripción completa del puesto antes de presentar su candidatura.

This is not a junior or entry-level position nor remote.

You will take technical ownership of cloud infrastructure, deployment pipelines, platform security, observability, reliability and production operations.

A key part of the role is working with AI coding and infrastructure agents such as Claude Code, Codex or equivalent tools. You must be able to instruct AI agents, review and audit their output, identify errors or security risks, and take responsibility for the final production result.

MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS
  • Minimum 5 years of professional experience in DevOps, SRE, Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering or a closely related role.
  • Proven responsibility for production systems.
  • Strong hands-on Google Cloud Platform experience.
  • Experience managing GCP environments across multiple projects.
  • Strong Terraform / Infrastructure as Code experience.
  • Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
  • Professional scripting experience with Bash, Python or equivalent.
  • Strong understanding of IAM, least-privilege access, service accounts and cloud permissions.
  • Experience managing secrets securely.
  • Experience implementing authentication between workloads without relying on long-lived static credentials.
  • Experience with production observability: logging, monitoring, metrics, alerting and incident investigation.
  • Hands-on experience managing production incidents.
  • Experience designing and testing backup and disaster-recovery procedures.
  • Experience implementing zero-downtime deployments and rollback strategies.
  • Experience with Git-based development and infrastructure workflows.
  • Practical experience using AI development agents such as Claude Code, Codex or equivalent tools.
  • Ability to review, validate and take responsibility for code or infrastructure generated by AI agents.
  • Ability to create clear technical documentation, operational runbooks and auditable procedures.
  • Ability and willingness to work 100% on-site in Barcelona, 5 days per week.
TECHNOLOGIES / EXPERIENCE WE VALUE
  • Terraform
  • Python / Bash
  • Git
  • GitHub Actions / GitLab CI / equivalent CI/CD systems
  • Docker
  • NoSQL databases
  • BigQuery
  • IAM
  • Workload Identity / Workload Identity Federation / OIDC
  • Prometheus / Grafana / OpenTelemetry / Google Cloud Operations
  • Security scanning and vulnerability management
  • Zero Trust architectures
AI-NATIVE DEVOPS

We expect AI agents to be part of the engineering workflow.

You may use tools such as Claude Code, Codex or equivalent systems to accelerate infrastructure development, scripting, debugging, documentation and operations.

However, AI-generated output must never be treated as automatically correct.

You will be expected to:
  • Give precise technical instructions to AI agents.
  • Review generated code and infrastructure changes.
  • Identify security, reliability and architectural issues.
  • Understand what the agent has changed and why.
  • Maintain human accountability for production systems.
  • Build documentation and runbooks that can also be consumed by AI agents through RAG-based systems.
RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Design, deploy and operate our Google Cloud infrastructure.
  • Manage multiple GCP projects and environments.
  • Develop and maintain Terraform infrastructure.
  • Design and maintain secure CI/CD pipelines.
  • Automate infrastructure and operational processes.
  • Manage IAM, service accounts, secrets and platform permissions.
  • Implement secure workload authentication without long-lived credentials.
  • Maintain logging, monitoring, alerting and observability.
  • Investigate and resolve production incidents.
  • Define SLI/SLO-based reliability practices.
  • Implement and test backup and disaster-recovery procedures.
  • Design deployment strategies including rolling, blue/green or canary deployments where appropriate.
  • Implement safe rollback procedures.
  • Review infrastructure and automation generated with AI tools.
  • Create technical documentation and operational runbooks.
  • Continuously improve platform reliability, security and operational efficiency.
EDUCATION

Preferred:

  • Computer Science
  • Software Engineering
  • Telecommunications Engineering
  • Information Systems or related technical degree

We also welcome strong candidates with vocational technical qualifications such as Systems Administration, Software Development or equivalent professional training when supported by significant relevant experience.

VALUABLE CERTIFICATIONS
  • Google Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer
  • Google Professional Cloud Architect
  • HashiCorp Terraform Associate
  • CKA / CKAD

Certifications are valuable, but real production experience, technical judgement and ownership are significantly more important.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We want someone who can independently make sound infrastructure decisions, identify risks before they reach production and take ownership when things go wrong.

We are particularly interested in engineers who understand that DevOps is not simply deploying software or maintaining CI/CD pipelines.

This role requires responsibility for reliability, security, automation and production operations. xqbhyrx

Location: Barcelona

Working model: 100% on-site

Salary bracket: depending on value, from 38K to 50K € before taxes.

description:

Para presentar una candidatura, simplemente lea la siguiente descripción del puesto y asegúrese de adjuntar los documentos pertinentes.

On this occasion, we are looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to join our Network Intelligence area. As a Future Connections developer, you will be part of a multidisciplinary team of Telco engineers and software developers building cross-platform applications for network optimisation, automation, performance monitoring and evaluation, data analytics and visualisation.

The core of this role is data. Our applications ingest large volumes of network performance data, transform it, analyse it, and surface it to engineers who act on the results. You will spend a substantial part of your time working with data in Python, building the transformations, the analysis and the pipelines behind them, and the rest exposing that work through APIs and interfaces engineers rely on during live operations.

We're also looking for someone who genuinely embraces AI-assisted development as a core part of how they work, using tools like Claude, GitHub Copilot or similar to design, build and ship faster, while still applying solid engineering judgement to review, validate and take ownership of everything that goes into production. This is not an entry-level profile: we need someone with real hands-on experience who knows when to trust AI and when to take the wheel.

As part of your role, you will…Data & analytics
  • Transform and analyse large volumes of network performance data in Python with Pandas and NumPy.
  • Build and maintain data pipelines, batch and streaming, with attention to correctness, completeness and behaviour under load.
  • Model analytical data and work with modern storage formats.
Back-End
  • Develop Python services with FastAPI and Flask, exposing the analytical layer through REST APIs.
  • Work with SQL and NoSQL databases.
  • Use efficient architecture based on microservices and distributed systems with Docker, Kubernetes, Kafka, Linux and AWS.
Front-End
  • Develop modern components using TypeScript and ReactJS.
  • Implement responsive and accessible interfaces with TailwindCSS, including data visualisation for operational use.
Across the stack
  • Use AI-assisted development tools (such as Claude, GitHub Copilot or similar) to enhance and accelerate development, on both Back-End and Front-End.

You will work in a collaborative, multivendor and multicustomer environment, contributing to projects for major wireless operators in Spain and across Europe. You'll operate within virtualised and cloud-based infrastructures (AWS, Azure, GCP), and will have the freedom to propose new tools, frameworks or methodologies to improve our applications.

Requirements
  • +4 years of experience in software development.
  • Strong data work in Python: transforming and analysing datasets with Pandas and NumPy. This is the core competency for the role.
  • Hands-on Back-End Python with frameworks such as FastAPI and Flask.
  • Experience building data pipelines at volume, batch and/or streaming, including data quality, consistency and completeness across large datasets.
  • Experience developing distributed, event-driven applications using technologies such as Kafka, asynchronous processing and microservice architectures.
  • Strong experience designing and integrating REST APIs, with familiarity with API contracts, authentication and service-to-service communication.
  • Proficient in TypeScript with experience developing Front-End applications using React.
  • Experience working with SQL and NoSQL databases.
  • Knowledge of containerisation and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Familiarity with cloud environments (e.g. AWS, Azure or GCP).
  • Solid, hands‑on experience using AI-assisted development tools across the full stack — able to prompt, review and validate AI-generated code with confidence.
  • Familiarity with application monitoring, structured logging, metrics and distributed tracing in cloud-native environments.
  • Experience implementing unit, integration, end-to-end and API contract testing.
  • English level B2 or higher
Nice to have

Familiarity with mobile network KPIs, alarms, OSS concepts and 4G/5G network data structures. We do not expect a telecom background, but curiosity about it.

  • Competitive salary, health insurance and Flexible Compensation Planas an enterprise benefit
  • Annual training budgetto help you stay technologically up to date and grow professionally.
  • Time flexibility:our life is not just a working day; we give you flexibility both in entry and exit. In addition, we enjoy a reduced working day on Fridays and Summer (July and August)
  • Our projects arecutting-edgein technology and are in both national and international environments, making your growth global

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
NUMBERO , a leading German tech startup revolutionizing after-sales processes in car dealerships, is looking for a Full Stack Engineer (m/f/d) to join our growing development hub in Valencia.


¿Tiene las habilidades necesarias para este puesto? Lea todos los detalles a continuación y presente su candidatura hoy mismo.
Who We Are

At NUMBERO, our mission is to equip car dealerships with cutting-edge tools to optimize their after-sales operations.

We integrate trusted sources for parts and labor costs, various Dealer Management Systems, and other relevant data sources.

We also leverage metadata analysis to drive intelligent insights.

Headquartered in Germany and supported by a growing international team, we focus on innovation, collaboration, and delivering outstanding value to our clients.

Our Valencia office plays a key role in shaping the future of our technologies and services.

About The Role

We are looking for a versatile Full Stack Engineer with strong backend and data engineering skills.

You will work across a Node.js backend, React and TypeScript frontend, and data platforms such as Databricks, supporting data pipelines, integrations, analytics, and AI-driven features.

The role requires end-to-end ownership, from database and API design through frontend delivery, deployment, and monitoring.

You should be comfortable working across application development, data workflows, job queues, migrations, authentication, and production systems.

Core Responsibilities
  • Develop and maintain web application features across the full stack (React + TypeScript frontend, Express.js + TypeScript backend)
  • Design and implement database schemas, migrations, and optimized queries (MySQL / MariaDB)
  • Build and maintain REST APIs and integrate them with frontend systems
  • Work with background job processing, scheduled tasks, and asynchronous workflows
  • Contribute to AI-driven features, LLM integrations, and prompt engineering
  • Integrate web applications with data platforms (PowerBI, Databricks, Azure Data Lake Storage)
  • Ensure scalable, secure, and production-ready implementations
  • Maintain high test coverage and participate in code reviews
  • Monitor and debug production systems independently
  • Collaborate with technical and business stakeholders
Required Technical SkillsFrontend & Web
  • Strong expertise in React + TypeScript
  • Advanced HTML5 / CSS3 (Bootstrap, Tailwind CSS)
  • REST API design and consumption
  • Git version control
Backend & Infrastructure
  • Solid experience with Node.js + Express.js
  • MySQL / MariaDB - schema design, query optimization, connection pooling, migrations
  • Redis - caching, job queues, distributed locking
  • Background job processing (BullMQ or similar queue systems)
  • Docker - containerization, multi-stage builds, Docker Compose
  • JWT authentication and role-based access control
  • Scheduled task management (cron jobs)
Data & Cloud
  • Practical experience with Databricks and Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS)
  • Understanding of data pipelines and structured/unstructured data handling
  • Experience integrating web applications with data platforms (PowerBI, Databricks, ADLS)
  • Familiarity with Azure services (Azure AD, Static Web Apps, or similar)
  • Understanding of data synchronization pipelines and ETL processes
AI & Prompt Engineering
  • Understanding of AI-driven applications and LLM integrations
  • Ability to design, test, and refine prompts for reliable AI outputs
  • Experience working with AI APIs (OpenAI, Azure AI, Anthropic, etc.)
Code Quality & Security
  • Writing and maintaining unit tests (Jest, Supertest)
  • Maintaining high test coverage standards (95%+ preferred)
  • Input validation and schema enforcement (Joi or similar)
  • Awareness of OWASP Top 10, rate limiting, CORS, and secure authentication flows
Nice To Have
  • PowerBI API integration and DAX queries
  • E2E testing frameworks (Cypress, Playwright)
  • PDF generation pipelines (pdf-lib, Puppeteer)
  • Email automation systems (Nodemailer, templated xqbhyrx dispatch)
  • Prometheus / Grafana monitoring
  • Azure Static Web Apps or similar deployment platforms
  • CI/CD pipeline configuration
Experience With Scalable Cloud Architecture (Azure Preferred)

UI/UX design awareness

Soft Skills
  • High ownership mentality - you treat features as yours from start to finish
  • Professional and structured communication
  • Strong problem-solving ability
  • AI-adaptive mindset - comfortable working with rapidly evolving technologies
  • Team-oriented but capable of independent execution
Requirements
  • Production-aware - you think about what happens after deployment
  • Professional experience of at least 3 years (mandatory)
  • English - Fluent (mandatory)
  • Spanish - Fluent (mandatory)
  • German - Nice to have
WHY IT'S A GREAT IDEA TO JOIN US

  • Company events and activities

  • Flexible working hours
  • Competitive salary based on your experience

  • Career development opportunities

title: Ekolog dopravních staveb
description:
Ekolog dopravních staveb

Miejsce pracy: Mohelnice, Olomouc
Region: zagranica

Opis stanowiska

Chcete řešit ekologii tam, kde má skutečný dopad? Přímo na stavbě?

Pro jeden z našich významných dálničních projektů D35 hledáme zkušeného kolegu nebo kolegyni, který/á převezme odpovědnost za oblast životního prostředí během realizace stavby.

Nečeká vás role, kde budete celý den sedět nad tabulkami a legislativou. Přibližně polovinu pracovního týdne strávíte přímo na stavbě, druhou část nad dokumentací, reportingem a komunikací s úřady.

Budete člověkem, za kterým se projektový tým obrátí, když bude potřeba najít řešení environmentálního problému v reálném stavebním provozu.

Co budete mít na starosti?
Vaším hlavním úkolem bude zajistit, aby realizace stavby probíhala v souladu s podmínkami EIA, stavebními povoleními, environmentální legislativou a našimi interními standardy.

V praxi budete:

  • pravidelně kontrolovat stavbu z pohledu ochrany životního prostředí,
  • dohlížet na plnění podmínek EIA a dalších povolení,
  • identifikovat environmentální rizika a navrhovat praktická nápravná opatření,
  • řešit odpadové hospodářství, včetně evidence, kontroly subdodavatelů a zákonných hlášení,
  • koordinovat témata spojená s povrchovými, dešťovými a podzemními vodami,
  • dohlížet na oblast ochrany přírody a krajiny, například kácení, skrývky ornice, biologický dozor nebo ochranná opatření na stavbě,
  • kontrolovat správné nakládání s chemickými a dalšími závadnými látkami,
  • připravovat a aktualizovat environmentální dokumentaci, havarijní a povodňové plány,
  • komunikovat s orgány státní správy, správci vodních toků a dalšími institucemi,
  • spolupracovat s vedením projektu, stavbyvedoucími, BOZP a subdodavateli,
  • školit zaměstnance a subdodavatele v environmentálních tématech.
  • Nebudete na to sami. Budete součástí projektového týmu a zároveň odborným partnerem lidí, kteří stavbu každý den řídí.

Jak bude vypadat váš pracovní týden?
Žádný týden nebude úplně stejný.

🏗️ 2 až 3 dny přímo na stavbě
Kontroly jednotlivých úseků, jednání se stavbyvedoucími a subdodavateli, kontrola environmentálních opatření nebo řešení aktuálních situací.

💻 2 až 3 dny práce s dokumentací
Evidence, reporting, příprava podkladů a hlášení, komunikace s úřady nebo příprava environmentální dokumentace projektu.

🤝 Průběžná spolupráce s projektem
Budete v kontaktu s vedením projektu, stavbyvedoucími, BOZP, subdodavateli, odbornými externisty i státní správou.

Wymagania

Koho hledáme?
Hledáme především člověka, který rozumí environmentální problematice ve stavebnictví a zároveň se nebojí obout pracovní boty a vyrazit přímo na stavbu.

Potřebovat budete:

  • SŠ nebo VŠ vzdělání v oblasti životního prostředí nebo příbuzném oboru,
  • alespoň 2 roky zkušeností s ochranou životního prostředí ve stavebnictví,
  • praktickou orientaci v odpadovém a vodním hospodářství, ochraně ovzduší, přírody a krajiny a nakládání se závadnými látkami,
  • zkušenost s komunikací se státní správou,
  • řidičský průkaz sk. B,
  • ochotu pravidelně pracovat přímo v terénu.
  • Velkou výhodou bude, pokud máte:
  • zkušenosti z dopravních nebo liniových staveb, například dálnic, silnic nebo železnic,
  • zkušenost s plněním podmínek EIA během realizace stavby,
  • praxi na větším infrastrukturním nebo stavebním projektu,
  • zkušenost z ČIŽP, ORP, krajského úřadu nebo jiné instituce státní správy,
  • odbornou způsobilost v oblasti ochrany přírody a krajiny,
  • zkušenosti s biologickým nebo ekologickým dozorem.

Nesplňujete všechno? Nevadí. Pokud máte zkušenosti s environmentální problematikou při realizaci větších staveb a dokážete samostatně hledat řešení v praxi, rádi se s vámi potkáme.

Oferujemy

V téhle roli se budete cítit dobře, pokud…

  • nechcete řešit životní prostředí jen od kancelářského stolu,
  • jste samostatní a dokážete si svou oblast převzít od A do Z,
  • umíte si obhájit odborný názor i před zkušeným stavbyvedoucím,
  • místo konstatování „tohle nejde“ raději hledáte způsob, jak to udělat správně a zároveň realizovatelně,
  • dokážete komunikovat s lidmi na stavbě stejně dobře jako s úřady,
  • jste důslední, ale zároveň praktičtí.


Proč pro nás?
Čeká vás práce, při které budou výsledky skutečně vidět.

Dostanete prostor samostatně řídit environmentální oblast významného infrastrukturního projektu a pracovat s tématy, která jsou mnohem širší než běžná environmentální administrativa.

Co vám za to nabídneme?

  • 27 dní dovolené ročně
  • služební automobil i pro soukromé účely
  • flexibilní benefity v hodnotě 2 500 Kč měsíčně, které můžete využít například na Multisport, DPS, DIP, sport, kulturu nebo zdraví
  • stravenkový paušál 110 Kč za pracovní den
  • motivační variabilní složku mzdy
  • balíček pojištění, včetně životního, úrazového a nemocničního
  • možnost odborného a kariérního růstu
  • podporu dalšího vzdělávání a profesního rozvoje
  • práci na velkých a technicky zajímavých projektech napříč Českou republikou
  • zázemí stabilní a rostoucí mezinárodní stavební společnosti

Rádi vám projekt i samotnou roli představíme osobně.

Aplikuj

Rádi bychom Vás informovali, že v Skupině Budimex platí postupy týkající se interního oznamování v souladu se Zákonem z 14. června 2024 o ochraně oznamovatelů (Sb. z roku 2024, 928).

  1. Osobní údaje mohou být předávány subjektům, jejichž prostřednictvím Správce dosahuje uvedených účelů, včetně subjektů udržujících IT infrastrukturu. V odůvodněných případech mohou být osobní údaje zpracovávány na dálku mimo Evropský hospodářský prostor (EHP). Pokud by k takovému předání došlo - což se může stát mimo jiné v souvislosti s možným využíváním IT řešení založených na cloudových řešeních nebo obsluhovaných servisním střediskem umístěným mimo EHP ze strany Správce, Správce zajistí mechanismus, který v souladu s právem Evropské unie legalizuje předání a poskytuje odpovídající záruky ochrany osobních údajů. Kopii popisu technických bezpečnostních opatření používaných k zabezpečení údajů přenášených mimo EHP můžete získat zasláním žádosti na následující adresu: [email protected].

Doba uchovávání osobních údajů

  1. Osobní údaje budou uchovávány:
  • v případě souhlasu se zpracováním osobních údajů v budoucích přijímacích procesech - do odvolání souhlasu nebo po dobu 5 let od data udělení souhlasu;
  • pro využití předložených podkladů k žádosti o zaměstnání pro účely průzkumu spokojenosti s přijímacím nebo pracovním procesem, budou osobní údaje uchovávány po dobu jednoho roku od podání žádosti o danou pracovní nabídku, nebo do doby než podáte účinnou námitku proti zpracování osobních údajů;
  • v případě vedení přijímacího řízení a v případě sepsání pracovní smlouvy nebo jiné smlouvy po dobu, po kterou je uchovávání údajů vyžadováno příslušnými právními předpisy.

VAŠE PRÁVA

  1. V souvislosti se zpracováním osobních údajů máte následující práva:
  • právo na odvolání souhlasu, právo na přístup k údajům, právo na opravu údajů, právo na výmaz údajů, právo na omezení zpracování údajů, právo na přenos údajů,
  • souhlas lze odvolat písemně na následující e-mailovou adresu: [email protected]. Odvolání souhlasu nemá vliv na zákonnost zpracování, které bylo provedeno na základě souhlasu před jeho odvoláním,
  • právo vznést námitku proti zpracování údajů - pokud je zpracování vašich osobních údajů založeno na tzv. oprávněném zájmu a za podmínek uvedených v ustanoveních GDPR,
  • právo podat stížnost u dozorového úřadu (orgán veřejné moci zřízený k ochraně základních práv a svobod fyzických osob v souvislosti se zpracováním osobních údajů a k usnadnění volného pohybu osobních údajů v rámci Unie).

title: Cloud Security Engineer
description:
Key Responsibilities

1. Cloud Security Architecture & Design Controls

  • Design and implement secure, scalable, and resilient AWS cloud architectures aligned with enterprise security standards and best practices.
  • Define security controls for AWS environments, including account structures, landing zones, workload isolation, and security boundaries.
  • Design and implement network segmentation using VPCs, subnets, security groups, Network ACLs, AWS Network Firewall, and other cloud-native security controls.
  • Establish appropriate security controls for internet-facing, internal, and highly sensitive workloads.
  • Design secure connectivity between AWS, on-premises data centers, and third-party environments.
  • Implement encryption for data at rest and in transit using services and technologies such as AWS KMS, TLS/SSL, and certificate management.
  • Conduct security architecture reviews for new cloud workloads, migrations, application modernization, and cloud transformation initiatives.
  • Identify security risks in proposed architectures and provide practical recommendations to mitigate those risks.
  • Develop and maintain cloud security reference architectures, security patterns, standards, and design guidelines.
  • Ensure security controls are consistently applied across development, testing, and production environments.

2. Identity & Access Management (IAM)

  • Design and maintain robust Identity and Access Management (IAM) controls based on the principles of least privilege and zero trust.
  • Define and manage IAM roles, policies, permission boundaries, service roles, and cross-account access.
  • Implement and enforce Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) and strong authentication mechanisms.
  • Establish appropriate access controls for employees, administrators, applications, workloads, and third-party users.
  • Implement secure privileged-access mechanisms for administrative and high-risk accounts.
  • Integrate AWS environments with enterprise Identity Providers and Single Sign-On (SSO) platforms.
  • Regularly review IAM permissions to identify excessive, unused, or inappropriate access.
  • Identify and remediate risks such as overly permissive IAM policies, exposed credentials, inactive accounts, and inappropriate privilege escalation paths.
  • Establish processes for joiner, mover, and leaver access management.
  • Support periodic access reviews and provide evidence for security and compliance audits.

3. Security Automation & DevSecOps

  • Integrate security controls and automated security checks into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Implement security testing across infrastructure, application, container, and cloud configurations.
  • Use Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform to consistently deploy and manage cloud security controls.
  • Implement automated checks for infrastructure misconfigurations, insecure configurations, and policy violations before deployment.
  • Introduce policy-as-code and automated compliance validation where appropriate.
  • Automate remediation of common cloud security misconfigurations and security findings.
  • Work closely with DevOps and engineering teams to embed DevSecOps practices into the software development lifecycle.
  • Develop reusable Terraform modules, security templates, policies, and automation frameworks.
  • Ensure security controls are repeatable, auditable, version-controlled, and integrated into automated deployment processes.
  • Continuously improve the organization's security posture through automation and standardization.

Key Attributes

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to translate security requirements into practical cloud architectures and technical controls.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Ability to work across architecture, engineering, DevOps, infrastructure, and security teams.
  • Strong ownership of security risks and remediation.
  • Ability to balance security, business requirements, operational considerations, and delivery timelines.

title: Private Lacrosse Coach
description:
Coach lacrosse on your own schedule in Wilmington, Delaware.

STXZ Lacrosse has 1 opening(s) for independent lacrosse coaches in the Wilmington area, to cover client requests for private lessons we can't currently fill. We bring you the clients. You run the sessions.

About STXZ

STXZ is a technology platform that connects families with independent lacrosse coaches across the United States. We send you clients in your area, handle the administrative work, and get out of your way so you can coach. If you have lacrosse experience and want coaching work on a flexible schedule, this is for you.

How it works

When a family near Wilmington requests lessons through STXZ, we send you a client offer with the details. You review it and decide whether to take it. No quotas, no pressure, no penalty for declining.

When you accept:

  • You contact the client directly within 24 hours
  • You and the client agree on schedule and location: their home, a local field, a park, your call
  • You run the session your way. Drills, pacing, and structure are your professional judgment
  • You submit a quick lesson briefing on the platform after the session
  • You get paid

STXZ never tells you how to coach, what drills to use, or how to structure your lessons.

What you earn

  • $35 to $50 per one-hour session, paid as a flat per-lesson rate. Rates are set by STXZ, vary by market and demand, and are confirmed in writing before your first lesson.
  • Payout within 24 to 48 hours after you submit your lesson briefing, via PayPal
  • 1099-NEC issued at year end if you earn $2,000 or more through the platform
  • Paid per completed session. Lesson volume depends on client demand in your area, and STXZ does not guarantee a minimum number of lessons.
  • No fee to apply, and nothing to pay up front

Schedule

Most lessons run weekday afternoons and evenings and on weekends. Work when you want and pause your availability anytime.

What you control

  • Your schedule. Accept or decline every offer without penalty or impact on your standing.
  • Your methods. Drills, lesson plans, teaching style, all yours.
  • Your territory. Set your own travel radius, from a few miles to 35 or more.
  • Your approach. You decide what equipment to bring to each session.

What STXZ handles

  • Client acquisition. We market the platform and bring families to you.
  • Matching. We send you local client offers that fit your profile.
  • Payment processing. We collect from clients and pay you after each session.
  • Billing, refunds, and disputes. Our support team handles all of it. You coach.
  • Liability coverage. Active coaches are enrolled in STXZ's platform liability coverage program for sessions booked through STXZ. The program fee is $30 per year, and it is $0 down: nothing is due to get started or to begin receiving client offers. The fee is recovered from your first lesson payout once you start coaching. This is limited coverage for platform-booked sessions only; independent coaches may also choose to carry their own personal insurance.

Who this is for

  • Coaching experience at the youth, high school, club, or college level, or playing experience at the high school varsity, club, college, or professional level
  • 18 or older
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States
  • Willing to complete a third-party background check, arranged by STXZ, before receiving full client details
  • Reliable transportation to training locations in your area
  • Your own stick and basic training equipment: cones, balls, training aids
  • Strong communication with parents, players, and the STXZ team
  • Professionalism and confidence working independently with families and youth athletes

How to apply

Apply here (about 2 minutes). If your background fits, we send a short coaching profile questionnaire: playing history, coaching experience, positions, availability. After review and background screening, approved coaches start receiving local client offers.

STXZ is a technology platform that connects clients with independent lacrosse coaches. STXZ does not employ, supervise, manage, or control coaches or their training sessions. Coaches are engaged as independent contractors and are responsible for their own coaching methods, taxes, and scheduling. STXZ considers all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

title: Private Lacrosse Coach
description:
Coach lacrosse on your own schedule in Knoxville, Tennessee.

STXZ Lacrosse has 1 opening(s) for independent lacrosse coaches in the Knoxville area, to cover client requests for private lessons we can't currently fill. We bring you the clients. You run the sessions.

About STXZ

STXZ is a technology platform that connects families with independent lacrosse coaches across the United States. We send you clients in your area, handle the administrative work, and get out of your way so you can coach. If you have lacrosse experience and want coaching work on a flexible schedule, this is for you.

How it works

When a family near Knoxville requests lessons through STXZ, we send you a client offer with the details. You review it and decide whether to take it. No quotas, no pressure, no penalty for declining.

When you accept:

  • You contact the client directly within 24 hours
  • You and the client agree on schedule and location: their home, a local field, a park, your call
  • You run the session your way. Drills, pacing, and structure are your professional judgment
  • You submit a quick lesson briefing on the platform after the session
  • You get paid

STXZ never tells you how to coach, what drills to use, or how to structure your lessons.

What you earn

  • $35 to $50 per one-hour session, paid as a flat per-lesson rate. Rates are set by STXZ, vary by market and demand, and are confirmed in writing before your first lesson.
  • Payout within 24 to 48 hours after you submit your lesson briefing, via PayPal
  • 1099-NEC issued at year end if you earn $2,000 or more through the platform
  • Paid per completed session. Lesson volume depends on client demand in your area, and STXZ does not guarantee a minimum number of lessons.
  • No fee to apply, and nothing to pay up front

Schedule

Most lessons run weekday afternoons and evenings and on weekends. Work when you want and pause your availability anytime.

What you control

  • Your schedule. Accept or decline every offer without penalty or impact on your standing.
  • Your methods. Drills, lesson plans, teaching style, all yours.
  • Your territory. Set your own travel radius, from a few miles to 35 or more.
  • Your approach. You decide what equipment to bring to each session.

What STXZ handles

  • Client acquisition. We market the platform and bring families to you.
  • Matching. We send you local client offers that fit your profile.
  • Payment processing. We collect from clients and pay you after each session.
  • Billing, refunds, and disputes. Our support team handles all of it. You coach.
  • Liability coverage. Active coaches are enrolled in STXZ's platform liability coverage program for sessions booked through STXZ. The program fee is $30 per year, and it is $0 down: nothing is due to get started or to begin receiving client offers. The fee is recovered from your first lesson payout once you start coaching. This is limited coverage for platform-booked sessions only; independent coaches may also choose to carry their own personal insurance.

Who this is for

  • Coaching experience at the youth, high school, club, or college level, or playing experience at the high school varsity, club, college, or professional level
  • 18 or older
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States
  • Willing to complete a third-party background check, arranged by STXZ, before receiving full client details
  • Reliable transportation to training locations in your area
  • Your own stick and basic training equipment: cones, balls, training aids
  • Strong communication with parents, players, and the STXZ team
  • Professionalism and confidence working independently with families and youth athletes

How to apply

Apply here (about 2 minutes). If your background fits, we send a short coaching profile questionnaire: playing history, coaching experience, positions, availability. After review and background screening, approved coaches start receiving local client offers.

STXZ is a technology platform that connects clients with independent lacrosse coaches. STXZ does not employ, supervise, manage, or control coaches or their training sessions. Coaches are engaged as independent contractors and are responsible for their own coaching methods, taxes, and scheduling. STXZ considers all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

title: Data & Ai Engineer
description:
Client. AI-native B2B SaaS Scale-up

We aren't looking for someone to add an LLM API to an existing product.

We're looking for the engineer who can decide how the AI system should actually work in production.

Our client is a fast-growing European B2B software company helping distributed organisations automate high-volume operational and compliance-heavy workflows.

Its platform combines enterprise data, documents, external systems and AI agents to automate work that historically required people to move information between emails, PDFs, legacy applications and back-office systems.

The company has passed the experimental stage. Customers already use AI-powered workflows in production.

The challenge now is reliability and scale.

How do you make agents predictable? How do you measure them? What belongs in the prompt, retrieval layer or deterministic software? When should a model be allowed to take an action? How do you manage permissions, cost, latency and fallbacks?

Those are the problems you'll own.

The role

As Lead Data & AI Engineer, you'll be the senior technical reference for a small group of Data and AI Engineers.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role, not a people-management job disguised as engineering.

Expect approximately 60-70% hands-on engineering, with the rest spent on architecture, technical direction, mentoring and working with Product, Security and Data.

What you'll own

  • Define the architecture of production AI systems built around LLMs, retrieval and agentic workflows.

  • Design multi-step agents, tool use, function calling, memory and state-management patterns.

  • Decide where deterministic software should replace probabilistic model behaviour.

  • Build reliable RAG systems covering ingestion, chunking, embeddings, retrieval, re-ranking and grounding.

  • Design model abstraction and routing so the product isn't unnecessarily locked into one provider.

  • Introduce systematic AI evaluation: offline datasets, regression suites, production metrics and experimentation.

  • Build observability covering traces, prompts, retrieval results, model responses, latency, cost and failures.

  • Implement guardrails, structured output validation, retries, fallbacks and human review for higher-risk actions.

  • Design AI-ready data architectures and interfaces between enterprise data and AI services.

  • Own LLMOps/MLOps patterns for versioning, testing, rollout and rollback.

  • Partner with Security and Legal on access control, privacy, responsible AI and EU regulatory requirements.

  • Review architecture and code while still shipping meaningful production code yourself.

  • Mentor engineers and help define technical standards as the team grows.

  • Translate business problems into engineering decisions rather than treating “AI” as the requirement.

Technical environment

The exact stack evolves, but today you'll encounter:

Core: Python, FastAPI, SQL, Git
AI: Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, LangGraph / Semantic Kernel
Retrieval: embeddings, vector/hybrid search, re-ranking
Data & ML: Databricks, MLflow
Platform: containers, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD
Observability: distributed tracing, AI eval tooling, production monitoring

Experience with equivalent technologies is absolutely valid.

We care more about whether you understand the underlying engineering problem than whether you've used one particular framework.

What we're looking for

  • 7+ years in software, data or ML engineering, with meaningful production ownership.

  • Previous technical leadership or architecture responsibility.

  • Strong Python/software-engineering fundamentals.

  • Hands‑on experience taking an LLM, RAG or agent‑based system beyond prototype stage and into production.

  • Deep understanding of the failure modes of LLM applications.

  • Experience with cloud architecture, APIs and distributed systems.

  • A strong evaluation mindset: “it seemed to work in testing” isn't enough.

  • Ability to reason across data, ML and software architecture rather than treating them as separate worlds.

  • Experience making technical decisions involving security, privacy, reliability and cost.

  • Ability to explain complex systems clearly to engineers, Product and business stakeholders.

  • Strong professional English.
Nice to have

Enterprise search, MCP, model fine-tuning, responsible AI, Azure AI, MLflow, Databricks, event-driven architectures or experience building software in regulated domains.

What success looks like

After your first months, the team should be able to answer questions it currently can't answer reliably:

Why did the agent make that decision?

Which retrieval change improved quality?

Did the new model actually outperform the old one?

What does one successful workflow cost?

Which AI failures reach customers?

Can we roll this version back safely?

And, crucially: should this particular problem use an LLM at all?

What you'll get

  • €75k-90k base salary depending on scope and experience.

  • Annual performance bonus and/or equity package.

  • Permanent contract.

  • Hybrid setup: around two office days per week in Barcelona or Madrid.

  • Flexible schedule.
  • Private health insurance.
  • Flexible compensation.
  • Training and conference budget.
  • 25+ working days' holiday.

  • High-end equipment and home-office support.

  • Direct influence over the AI architecture rather than inheriting decisions made several layers above you.

Hiring process

1. Talent / role conversation: 45 min

2. AI systems deep dive: 75 minYou'll discuss a system you've built and design a production AI architecture with one of our senior engineers.

3. Leadership & Product conversation: 60 minTrade-offs, influence, technical leadership and business thinking.

4. References and offer.

No five-round interview marathon and no take-home project that consumes your weekend.

We hire this profile on an ongoing basis. Depending on current team needs, the process may lead to an immediate opportunity or to our priority talent network.

title: Private Lacrosse Coach
description:
Coach lacrosse on your own schedule in Riverside, California.

STXZ Lacrosse has 1 opening(s) for independent lacrosse coaches in the Riverside area, to cover client requests for private lessons we can't currently fill. We bring you the clients. You run the sessions.

About STXZ

STXZ is a technology platform that connects families with independent lacrosse coaches across the United States. We send you clients in your area, handle the administrative work, and get out of your way so you can coach. If you have lacrosse experience and want coaching work on a flexible schedule, this is for you.

How it works

When a family near Riverside requests lessons through STXZ, we send you a client offer with the details. You review it and decide whether to take it. No quotas, no pressure, no penalty for declining.

When you accept:

  • You contact the client directly within 24 hours
  • You and the client agree on schedule and location: their home, a local field, a park, your call
  • You run the session your way. Drills, pacing, and structure are your professional judgment
  • You submit a quick lesson briefing on the platform after the session
  • You get paid

STXZ never tells you how to coach, what drills to use, or how to structure your lessons.

What you earn

  • $35 to $50 per one-hour session, paid as a flat per-lesson rate. Rates are set by STXZ, vary by market and demand, and are confirmed in writing before your first lesson.
  • Payout within 24 to 48 hours after you submit your lesson briefing, via PayPal
  • 1099-NEC issued at year end if you earn $2,000 or more through the platform
  • Paid per completed session. Lesson volume depends on client demand in your area, and STXZ does not guarantee a minimum number of lessons.
  • No fee to apply, and nothing to pay up front

Schedule

Most lessons run weekday afternoons and evenings and on weekends. Work when you want and pause your availability anytime.

What you control

  • Your schedule. Accept or decline every offer without penalty or impact on your standing.
  • Your methods. Drills, lesson plans, teaching style, all yours.
  • Your territory. Set your own travel radius, from a few miles to 35 or more.
  • Your approach. You decide what equipment to bring to each session.

What STXZ handles

  • Client acquisition. We market the platform and bring families to you.
  • Matching. We send you local client offers that fit your profile.
  • Payment processing. We collect from clients and pay you after each session.
  • Billing, refunds, and disputes. Our support team handles all of it. You coach.
  • Liability coverage. Active coaches are enrolled in STXZ's platform liability coverage program for sessions booked through STXZ. The program fee is $30 per year, and it is $0 down: nothing is due to get started or to begin receiving client offers. The fee is recovered from your first lesson payout once you start coaching. This is limited coverage for platform-booked sessions only; independent coaches may also choose to carry their own personal insurance.

Who this is for

  • Coaching experience at the youth, high school, club, or college level, or playing experience at the high school varsity, club, college, or professional level
  • 18 or older
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States
  • Willing to complete a third-party background check, arranged by STXZ, before receiving full client details
  • Reliable transportation to training locations in your area
  • Your own stick and basic training equipment: cones, balls, training aids
  • Strong communication with parents, players, and the STXZ team
  • Professionalism and confidence working independently with families and youth athletes

How to apply

Apply here (about 2 minutes). If your background fits, we send a short coaching profile questionnaire: playing history, coaching experience, positions, availability. After review and background screening, approved coaches start receiving local client offers.

STXZ is a technology platform that connects clients with independent lacrosse coaches. STXZ does not employ, supervise, manage, or control coaches or their training sessions. Coaches are engaged as independent contractors and are responsible for their own coaching methods, taxes, and scheduling. STXZ considers all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

title: Data Architect
description:
Enso Recruitment are delighted to be partnering with a well-established, globally operating SaaS business that has been at the forefront of its niche for nearly two decades.


They are now on the lookout for a talentedData Architectto shape what comes next.


The Opportunity

This is a genuinely high-impact role. The business is on a mission to bring together data from across its multi-product estate into a unified, governed platform, unlocking smarter analytics, deeper customer insights, and a foundation for AI-driven development.


As Data Architect, you will own how that data is structured, connected, and governed across the organisation. It's a role with strong visibility, real strategic ownership, and the chance to shape how data is used at scale for years to come.


Key Responsibilities

  • Author and maintain the canonical data model across a multi-product estate, covering logical and physical modelling, entity relationships, slowly changing dimensions, and tenant isolation patterns
  • Define data contracts with product teams and own the data dictionary, naming standards, and reference data governance
  • Lead master data management including entity resolution, golden records, and cross-product joins at scale
  • Define data domains, ownership boundaries, and clear data ownership and governance that works across a product-led structure
  • Design the semantic and query layer for analysts, products, customers, and AI agents, setting standards across cataloguing, lineage, data quality, access control, and PII handling
  • Define the Lakehouse target architecture covering storage, table format, query engine, ingestion, and metadata standards
  • Set patterns for multi-tenant isolation and row and column-level security
  • Define streaming and batch ingestion architecture, building on existing investments in NATS JetStream, Apache Flink, and Debezium CDC patterns
  • Partner with senior stakeholders to ensure architecture delivers against the product roadmap
  • Establish architecture review forums and set the standard as the data team continues to grow


About You

  • 8+ years in data or information architecture within a multi-product SaaS environment
  • Deep expertise in conceptual, logical, and physical data modelling, master data management, and domain-oriented governance
  • Strong track record of reconciling divergent source systems into unified canonical models
  • Solid grounding in Lakehouse architecture trade-offs including table formats, query engines, and ingestion patterns
  • Hands-on experience with Dremio, Snowflake, or Databricks
  • Hands-on experience with AWS data services such as S3, Glue, Athena, or Lake Formation
  • Experience with NATS, Apache Kafka, and CDC patterns such as Debezium
  • Stream processing experience using Apache Flink, Spark Structured Streaming, or equivalent
  • Strong SQL skills and experience with query optimisation at scale
  • Familiarity with data and table formats including Parquet, Avro, Apache Iceberg, and Delta Lake
  • Ability to communicate architecture decisions clearly across engineering, product, and executive audiences


Benefits

  • Flexible, Hybrid Working
  • 10% Bonus
  • Great PTO
  • Private Health Insurance including Dental and Optical cover
  • Training and Development Opportunities
  • Pension


To find out more about this opportunity, submit your CV, or reach out to a member of the Enso Recruitment team today!

title: Lead Data & AI Engineer - GenAI & AI Platforms
description:
Client. AI-native B2B SaaS Scale-up

Inscríbase ahora, lea los detalles del trabajo desplazándose hacia abajo. Verifique que posee las habilidades necesarias antes de enviar una solicitud.

We aren't looking for someone to add an LLM API to an existing product.


We're looking for the engineer who can decide how the AI system should actually work in production.


Our client is a fast-growing European B2B software company helping distributed organisations automate high-volume operational and compliance-heavy workflows.


Its platform combines enterprise data, documents, external systems and AI agents to automate work that historically required people to move information between emails, PDFs, legacy applications and back-office systems.


The company has passed the experimental stage. Customers already use AI-powered workflows in production.


The challenge now is reliability and scale.


How do you make agents predictable? How do you measure them? What belongs in the prompt, retrieval layer or deterministic software? When should a model be allowed to take an action? How do you manage permissions, cost, latency and fallbacks?


Those are the problems you'll own.


The role

As Lead Data & AI Engineer, you'll be the senior technical reference for a small group of Data and AI Engineers.


This is a hands-on technical leadership role, not a people-management job disguised as engineering.


Expect approximately 60-70% hands-on engineering, with the rest spent on architecture, technical direction, mentoring and working with Product, Security and Data.


What you'll own

  • Define the architecture of production AI systems built around LLMs, retrieval and agentic workflows.


  • Design multi-step agents, tool use, function calling, memory and state-management patterns.


  • Decide where deterministic software should replace probabilistic model behaviour.


  • Build reliable RAG systems covering ingestion, chunking, embeddings, retrieval, re-ranking and grounding.


  • Design model abstraction and routing so the product isn't unnecessarily locked into one provider.


  • Introduce systematic AI evaluation: offline datasets, regression suites, production metrics and experimentation.


  • Build observability covering traces, prompts, retrieval results, model responses, latency, cost and failures.


  • Implement guardrails, structured output validation, retries, fallbacks and human review for higher-risk actions.


  • Design AI-ready data architectures and interfaces between enterprise data and AI services.


  • Own LLMOps/MLOps patterns for versioning, testing, rollout and rollback.


  • Partner with Security and Legal on access control, privacy, responsible AI and EU regulatory requirements.


  • Review architecture and code while still shipping meaningful production code yourself.


  • Mentor engineers and help define technical standards as the team grows.


  • Translate business problems into engineering decisions rather than treating “AI” as the requirement.



Technical environment

The exact stack evolves, but today you'll encounter:


Core: Python, FastAPI, SQL, Git
AI: Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, LangGraph / Semantic Kernel
Retrieval: embeddings, vector/hybrid search, re-ranking
Data & ML: Databricks, MLflow
Platform: containers, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD
Observability: distributed tracing, AI eval tooling, production monitoring


Experience with equivalent technologies is absolutely valid.


We care more about whether you understand the underlying engineering problem than whether you've used one particular framework.


What we're looking for

  • 7+ years in software, data or ML engineering, with meaningful production ownership.


  • Previous technical leadership or architecture responsibility.


  • Strong Python/software-engineering fundamentals.


  • Hands‑on experience taking an LLM, RAG or agent‑based system beyond prototype stage and into production.


  • Deep understanding of the failure modes of LLM applications.


  • Experience with cloud architecture, APIs and distributed systems.


  • A strong evaluation mindset: “it seemed to work in testing” isn't enough.


  • Ability to reason across data, ML and software architecture rather than treating them as separate worlds.


  • Experience making technical decisions involving security, privacy, reliability and cost.


  • Ability to explain complex systems clearly to engineers, Product and business stakeholders.


  • Strong professional English.

Nice to have

Enterprise search, MCP, model fine-tuning, responsible AI, Azure AI, MLflow, Databricks, event-driven architectures or experience building software in regulated domains.


What success looks like

After your first months, the team should be able to answer questions it currently can't answer reliably:


Why did the agent make that decision?


Which retrieval change improved quality?


Did the new model actually outperform the old one?


What does one successful workflow cost?


Which AI failures reach customers?


Can we roll this version back safely?


And, crucially: should this particular problem use an LLM at all?


What you'll get

  • €75k-90k base salary depending on scope and experience.


  • Annual performance bonus and/or equity package.


  • Permanent contract.

  • Hybrid setup: around two office days per week in Barcelona or Madrid.


  • Flexible schedule.
  • Private health insurance.
  • Flexible compensation.
  • Training and conference budget.
  • 25+ working days' holiday.

  • High-end equipment and home-office support.


  • Direct influence over the AI architecture rather than inheriting decisions made several layers above you.



Hiring process

1. Talent / role conversation: 45 min


2. AI systems deep dive: 75 minYou'll discuss a system you've built and design a production AI architecture with one of our senior engineers.


3. Leadership & Product conversation: 60 minTrade-offs, influence, technical leadership and business thinking.


4. References and offer.


No five-round interview marathon and no take-home project that consumes your weekend.


We hire this profile on an ongoing basis. xqbhyrx Depending on current team needs, the process may lead to an immediate opportunity or to our priority talent network.

Most automation teams only have the first half, which is why most of them have a drawer full of demos and nothing in production.We are hiring the engineers for the second half.We are hiring at two levels, and we would rather say so than let you guess.

title: VoiceAI Engineer
location: Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh, Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
description:
Location: Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh,Hồ Chí Minh,Việt Nam

VoiceAI builds the real-time voice layer behind Trusting Social's AI agents, for both outbound and inbound calls. We own the cascade pipeline that connects the caller to the agent (ASR → LLM → TTS): real-time speech understanding (ASR), real-time speech generation (TTS), the real-time orchestration between speech and the LLM script, and the interaction behaviour on top, including turn-taking, latency, and answering machine detection. Our platform powers Kompato (AI collections for US fintech lenders) and Sophia (financial services sales in Vietnam and the Philippines), working closely with the Collin and Sophia DS and product teams, who own the LLM dialogue scripts, and the engineering team, who owns telephony and inbound routing and connects to our layer through the same interface for inbound and outbound calls.

About the role

You will build and operate the real-time interaction layer that makes our agents sound and behave like great human callers: fast, natural, and reliable under production load.

What you'll do

  • Own the real-time orchestration of the cascade pipeline (ASR → LLM → TTS): streaming transcripts into the LLM script, streaming its output into speech generation, and managing state and timing across components
  • Build and maintain the real-time voice components: real-time speech understanding, real-time speech generation, voice activity and end-of-turn detection, barge-in and interruption handling
  • Drive end-to-end latency down across the interaction layer, from audio in to first audio out
  • Integrate and switch between ASR/TTS vendors and self-hosted speech models behind clean, well-tested interfaces
  • Deploy and scale self-hosted speech models on GPU (batching, streaming inference, cost per call)
  • Own reliability of the interaction layer: monitoring, alerting, load testing, and incident response with Datadog
  • Work with Data Scientists to ship model improvements (e.g. AMD, TTS post-training) into production safely via A/B tests and staged rollouts
  • Collaborate with the Collin and Sophia DS and product teams on the interface between speech and the LLM script, and with engineering on telephony and inbound routing, maintaining a single interface for inbound and outbound calls

What we're looking for

  • Hands-on with a full-stack mindset: you own the whole lifecycle, from modelling and engineering to deployment and production monitoring
  • AI-native way of working: you use AI tools (coding agents, LLM assistants) every day to build, analyze, and ship faster
  • Real-time mindset, especially for voice and speech: you design for streaming and low latency by default, think in milliseconds, and care about how every delay and glitch sounds to the caller
  • 3+ years of backend or ML engineering, with production systems that handle real-time or streaming workloads
  • Strong Python; experience with async/concurrent programming and WebSocket or WebRTC-based streaming
  • Hands-on experience with real-time voice frameworks (LiveKit, Pipecat, or similar) or equivalent media pipelines
  • Experience integrating ASR/TTS APIs and reasoning about audio formats, codecs, buffering, and jitter
  • Solid engineering practices: testing, CI/CD, containers, cloud deployment, observability

Nice to have

  • Serving speech or LLM models on GPU (vLLM, Triton, TensorRT, or similar)
  • Familiarity with SIP/telephony concepts
  • Experience with speech-to-speech models or cascade vs. S2S architecture trade-offs
  • Vietnamese, Tagalog, or US English voice product experience

What We Offer

Join our vibrant team and enjoy:

  • Opportunity to work and learn from one of the best and brightest technology teams in Vietnam
  • Be part of a winning team with exponential growth regionally, experience recruiting world-class talents
  • Competitive compensation package, including 13th-month salary and performance bonuses
  • Comprehensive health care coverage for you and your dependents
  • Generous leave policies, including annual leave, sick leave, and flexible work hours
  • Convenient central district 1 office location, next to a future metro station
  • On-site lunch with multiple options, including vegetarian
  • Grab for work allowance and fully equipped workstations
  • Fun and engaging team building activities, sponsored sports clubs, and happy hour every Thursday
  • Unlimited free coffee, tea, snacks, and fruit to keep you energized
  • An opportunity to make a social impact by helping to democratize credit access in emerging markets

If you're smart, driven, and want to make a difference in the world with the most advanced and fascinating technology, come join our team. We offer the runway to truly make an impact.

If you are applying for this role and you do not meet the new eligibility criteria for sponsorship (or the transitional provisions), you will need to consider your options for obtaining and/or maintaining your right to work in the UK in light of these changes.

title: Diagnostiekstage in Gouda, Voorburg of Zoetermeer
description:
Diagnostiek stage in Gouda, Voorburg of Zoetermeer

Wil jij tijdens je wo-masterstage veel praktijkervaring opdoen met diagnostiek binnen de kinder- en jeugdpsychiatrie? Bij YOEP werk je mee aan diagnostische trajecten, leer je van ervaren (GZ-) Psychologen en krijg je, onder begeleiding, steeds meer verantwoordelijkheid.
We hebben stageplekken beschikbaar in Gouda, Voorburg en Zoetermeer. Op het sollicitatieformulier kan je aangeven welke locatie je voorkeur heeft.
Deze stage begint op 1 februari 2027. Je loopt bij ons 9 maanden, 3 dagen per week (24 uur) stage. Tijdens je stage werk je met kinderen en jongeren van 6 tot 18 jaar. We kunnen daarbij niet garanderen dat je uitsluitend met een specifieke leeftijdsgroep zult werken. Onze stageplekken vinden plaats op locaties gericht op kinder- en jeugdpsychiatrie.
Een stage binnen de volwassenenzorg bieden we bij YOEP op dit moment niet.
De nadruk van de stage ligt op diagnostiek. Het is daarom ook mogelijk om de Basisaantekening (Psycho)Diagnostiek (BAD) te behalen. Vanuit YOEP krijg je de praktijkervaring, begeleiding en supervisie die je nodig hebt om je hierin verder te ontwikkelen. Het nakijken van de casussen gebeurt binnen de universiteit.

Je stage bij YOEP

De eerste 2 à 3 maanden gebruik je vooral om rustig kennis te maken. Je kijkt mee met collega’s, leert onze organisatie en afdeling kennen en ontdekt met welke cliënten we werken. Je krijgt een beeld van hoe diagnostiek en behandeling eruitzien en maakt kennis met de sociale kaart rondom onze doelgroep.

Daarna krijg je steeds meer verantwoordelijkheid. Je begint met werkzaamheden onder supervisie en werkt toe naar zoveel mogelijk zelfstandig uitvoeren. De focus ligt vooral op diagnostische trajecten.

Je kunt bijvoorbeeld bezig zijn met:

  • diagnostisch onderzoek en verslaglegging;

  • het opstellen en meedenken over behandelplannen;

  • het plannen en organiseren van afspraken;

  • meedenken over het hele traject van een cliënt;

  • aansluiten bij MDO’s en teamvergaderingen;

  • psycho-educatie geven;

  • aansluiten bij een groepsbehandeling.

Ook kun je meekijken bij behandelingen. Zo krijg je een goed beeld van wat er na een diagnostisch traject gebeurt en hoe de verschillende onderdelen van de zorg met elkaar samenhangen. Zelfstandig behandelingen uitvoeren is geen onderdeel van deze stage.

Begeleiding en ontwikkeling

We willen dat je tijdens je stage de ruimte krijgt om vragen te stellen, te oefenen en steeds zelfstandiger te worden. Daarom is er voldoende tijd voor stagebegeleiding en supervisie door een psycholoog of orthopedagoog. Je begint met meekijken en leren kennen. Daarna ga je onder supervisie steeds meer zelf doen. Natuurlijk hoef je dat niet alleen uit te zoeken: je wordt hierin begeleid en krijgt steeds meer ruimte om onderdelen zelfstandig op te pakken naarmate je stage vordert en dit past binnen je persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

Bij YOEP ben je dus niet alleen iemand die komt meekijken. Je draait mee in het team, denkt mee over cliënten en krijgt de kans om echt ervaring op te doen met het vak. Na je stage zijn er mogelijk kansen om bij YOEP aan de slag te gaan als behandelaar, afhankelijk van beschikbare vacatures en een passende match.

Wanneer kom je in aanmerking voor een stageplek bij YOEP?

We zijn opzoek naar een masterstudent die een opleiding orthopedagogiek, gezinspedagogiek of (klinische) kinder- en jeugdpsychologie volgt en vanuit zijn of haar opleiding minimaal 24 uur per week gedurende 9 maanden stage mogen lopen.

We worden nog enthousiaster van iemand die bewust kiest voor onze doelgroep en dit werkveld. We werken met kinderen en jongeren van 6 tot 18 jaar en zoeken daarom iemand die voldoende kennis heeft van hun ontwikkeling en van de verschillende vragen waarmee zij en hun gezinnen bij ons terechtkomen.

Volg je een opleiding of specialisatie in bijvoorbeeld neuropsychologie of forensische psychologie? Dan kun je ook solliciteren. We bekijken dan wel samen of de inhoud van onze stage en jouw leerdoelen goed bij elkaar passen.

Hoe werkt de selectie?

Vanaf 1 oktober zijn onze vacatures geopend voor stages met een startdatum van 1 februari 2027. Onze stagevacatures staan maximaal 3 weken open. Het komt soms voor dat de vacature eerder gesloten wordt vanwege hoge mate van interesse. Na afloop van de termijn laten

we je zo snel mogelijk weten of je doorgaat naar de volgende stap in het sollicitatieproces.

description:
