WELCOME TO SITA

We're the team that keeps airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our tech and communication innovations are the secret behind the success of the world's air travel industry.

You'll find us at 95% of international hubs. We partner closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients, each with their own unique needs and challenges. Our goal is to find fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to make their operations run like clockwork. Want to be a part of something big?

Are you ready to love your job? The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.

PURPOSE

You will be part of the highly talented individuals' team responsible for bringing the Air Transport Industry data to the next level. Your day by day will include working with Data Pipelines, extracting and digging into different Datasets coming from Airports, Airplanes, and Ground Handlers, to understand it and get insights that then we will use to train ML Models so we can make this industry more reliable and easier to operate. We at SITA are the biggest Tech Service provider worldwide for the Air Transport Industry. We have tons of data and now we want to make use of it to make our customers’ lives easier!

We are looking for a Data Engineer to join the Central Data Platform Team and design, develop, and maintain reference data patterns, templates, and frameworks on the centrally managed Databricks platform. You’ll support portfolio teams by enabling governance-aligned data engineering practices, ensuring data is produced in a consistent, secure, and scalable way without owning team data products or pipelines.

This position requires an office presence of 3 days a week on our offices near to Madrid Airport or in Barcelona city Centre.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Work together with the team in designing scalable cloud-based data architectures with a focus on performance, cost-efficiency, and security.

- Develop reference ingestion patterns and templates for integrating data from enterprise systems, APIs, and external datasets.

- Develop and maintain pipelines (e.g. platform services, system tables, reference implementations) and provide guidance on ETL/ELT best practices for portfolio teams.

- Apply and validate data governance, cataloguing, and quality monitoring (compliance with guidelines) to ensure trustworthy and well-documented data.

- Collaborate with data architects, scientists, analysts, and business stakeholders across the Air Transport Industry to translate requirements into technical solutions.

- Explore and apply modern technologies (e.g., Databricks, AzureML, LLMs) to enable advanced analytics and AI/ML use cases (use-case driven).

Qualifications:

TECHNICAL EXPERIENCE

- 5+ years of technical experience with Big Data systems.

- Familiarity with Databricks, Spark and event streaming (e.g. Azure Event Hub, Kafka).

- Proficiency in SQL and Python, with clean coding and OOP practices.

- Cloud deployment experience (Azure preferred).

- Nice to have: Knowledge of data visualization (e.g. Power BI, Databricks Dashboards, Tableau, etc).

- Nice to have: Strong understanding of dimensional modelling and data warehouse design.

PROFESSIONAL COMPETENCIES

- We will spend eight hours a day together, and we prefer to expending them with a good mood and a smile on our faces. Having a good atmosphere at work is a must on our teams!
- Strong collaboration skills, with the ability to enable and advise teams without taking ownership of their delivery.
- Proactive and solution-oriented mindset.
- Flexibility and adaptability in dynamic environments.
- Curiosity and eagerness to learn new tools and improve processes.

WHAT WE OFFER

We're all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We're really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.

Flex Week: Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team's needs)

Employee Wellbeing: We have got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health - a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs.

title: GZ Psycholoog Enschede | de Posten
description:
Als GZ-psycholoog bij de Posten zet je jouw kennis en ervaring in om ouderen te helpen omgaan met psychische, cognitieve en gedragsmatige uitdagingen. Je werkt in een betrokken en deskundig behandelteam waarin we kennis delen, elkaar helpen en samen verantwoordelijk zijn voor goede zorg. Zo draag je iedere dag bij aan passende zorg en waardevolle momenten.

Wat ga je doen

Je werkt met ouderen die te maken hebben met verschillende uitdagingen en draagt bij aan hun kwaliteit van leven en welzijn.

Je verricht diagnostiek en behandeling bij uiteenlopende hulpvragen, waaronder cognitieve problematiek, stemmingsklachten, gedragsverandering en persoonlijkheidsproblematiek. Daarbij kijk je niet alleen naar de klant, maar ook naar het systeem eromheen.

Je adviseer je zorgteams, familieleden en andere betrokkenen. Je vertaalt psychologische inzichten naar praktische benaderingsadviezen en ondersteunt medewerkers in het omgaan met complexe situaties.

Je bent niet alleen betrokken bij de zorg voor klanten, maar ook bij de doorontwikkeling van de vakgroep. Binnen de Posten werken we aan nieuwe vormen van regiebehandelaarschap en breiden we de mogelijkheden voor psychologische behandeling verder uit. Daarbij krijg je de ruimte om jouw expertise in te brengen en mee richting te geven aan deze ontwikkelingen.

Ook begeleid en superviseer je de masterpsychologen binnen de vakgroep.

Waarom de Posten

De Posten is een plek voor ouderen waar wonen, ontmoeten, ondersteuning en behandeling samenkomen. We zijn niet alleen een zorgorganisatie, maar ook een vertrouwd gezicht in de wijk. Een plek waar mensen zich welkom voelen en zichzelf kunnen zijn.

We kijken altijd eerst naar wat een bewoner of cliënt zelf kan en wil. Van daaruit zoeken we samen naar mogelijkheden. Met aandacht voor de mens, oog voor de omgeving en in samenwerking met familie, naasten en collega's.

Bij de Posten krijg je de ruimte om jouw expertise in te zetten én verder te ontwikkelen. We geloven in eigenaarschap, vertrouwen en samenwerken. Want de beste zorg ontstaat wanneer professionals hun kennis delen, initiatief nemen en elkaar versterken.

Wie ben jij?

  • Je bent geregistreerd als GZ-psycholoog;

  • Je bent nieuwsgierig naar de ouderenzorg;

  • Je kijkt verder dan de diagnose en hebt oog voor de mens achter de zorgvraag.;

  • Je werkt zelfstandig, maar zoekt ook actief de samenwerking op;

  • Je denkt mee over ontwikkelingen binnen het vak en durft initiatief te nemen;

  • Je communiceert gemakkelijk met cliënten, naasten en collega's.

Wat bieden wij

Bij de Posten kom je terecht in een hechte vakgroep waar de lijnen kort zijn en waar ruimte is om te sparren, leren en ontwikkelen. Je werkt samen met betrokken collega's die elkaar weten te vinden en die samenbouwen aan toekomstbestendige ouderenzorg. Je hebt veel eigen regie over je agenda, waarbij je werkzaamheden zelfstandig organiseert en tegelijkertijd afstemt met collega's en het team. Het is een veelzijdige functie waarin je jouw expertise breed kunt inzetten en volop ruimte krijgt voor eigen initiatief.

title: Lead Planner
description:
Overview

John Sisk & Son have been building excellence as a family-owned international construction company by offering trust, certainty and value to our clients whilst being at the heart of change.

We are seeking an experienced Lead Planner to take ownership of planning and programme management across a busy and growing construction framework operating within a live, highly regulated and challenging environment.

The role will be responsible for managing and coordinating multiple concurrent project programmes across the framework, from pre-construction through design, procurement, construction, commissioning and handover.

The successful candidate must have previous framework experience and be comfortable working across a portfolio of projects with different priorities, delivery stages, constraints and stakeholders.

As the framework and workload continue to grow, the Lead Planner will also be responsible for managing and developing a growing team of planners, establishing consistent planning standards, allocating workload and ensuring the planning function has the capability and capacity to support the wider business.

This is not simply a programme-update role. The Lead Planner will be expected to provide active planning leadership, challenge project teams and subcontractors, identify emerging programme risks, test programme logic and drive appropriate mitigation and recovery strategies.

Responsibilities

· Lead the planning and programme management function across a portfolio of concurrent construction projects.

· Manage and coordinate multiple programmes operating simultaneously within a framework environment.

· Lead, manage and develop a growing team of planners as the framework and business expand.

· Allocate planning resources across projects in accordance with workload, project priorities and delivery requirements.

· Support the recruitment, onboarding and development of additional planning resources as required.

· Provide technical guidance, mentoring and support to planners within the team.

· Establish and maintain consistent planning standards, processes, templates and reporting requirements across the framework.

· Review and assure the quality, logic and consistency of programmes produced by the planning team.

· Develop and maintain detailed programmes from pre-construction, design and procurement through construction, commissioning and handover.

· Establish appropriate programme structures, WBS, activities, logic, dependencies and milestones.

· Develop and maintain an integrated framework-level view of all projects, identifying resource, sequencing and programme interfaces.

· Work closely with Project Managers, Construction Managers and Design Managers to ensure design deliverables, surveys, approvals and information requirements are properly integrated into project programmes.

· Integrate procurement schedules, subcontractor lead times, manufacturing periods and long-lead items into the overall programme.

· Review subcontractor programmes and challenge durations, sequencing, assumptions, logic and resource requirements.

· Identify critical and near-critical activities and clearly communicate programme risks to the wider project team.

· Undertake critical path analysis and assess the impact of delays, changes and emerging constraints.

· Develop programme mitigation and recovery plans in conjunction with delivery teams.

· Monitor actual progress against baseline and current programmes and provide accurate forecasts.

· Highlight programme slippage at an early stage and ensure corrective actions are agreed, allocated and tracked.

· Support Project Managers in assessing the programme impact of client changes, design changes and Early Warning items.

· Maintain appropriate programme records to support commercial and contractual discussions.

· Work closely with the commercial team where programme events may have time or cost implications.

· Support extension-of-time and delay assessments where required.

· Facilitate regular programme reviews with project teams, subcontractors and the client.

· Produce clear weekly and monthly programme reporting covering progress, milestones, critical path, look-ahead activities, variance, constraints, design, procurement, risks and mitigation.

· Prepare short-term look-ahead programmes to support site delivery.

· Ensure shutdowns, isolations, permits, access restrictions and operational constraints are correctly incorporated within project programmes.

· Support development and continuous improvement of standard planning processes and programme templates across the framework.

· Provide planning support during tendering and pre-construction, including programme development, sequencing and buildability assessments.

· Participate in project risk reviews, progress meetings and client programme meetings.

· Ensure programmes remain realistic, forward-looking management tools rather than retrospective reporting documents.

· Work with senior management to forecast future planning-resource requirements in line with expected business growth and workload.

· Ensure programme management and reporting are aligned with the relevant NEC contractual requirements, including accepted programmes, Early Warnings, Compensation Events and programme revisions where applicable.

Experience

Essential Experience

· Significant planning experience within the construction industry.

· Previous experience working within a construction framework environment.

· Proven experience managing and coordinating multiple concurrent project programmes.

· Proven experience leading, managing or mentoring a team of planners.

· Ability to manage and develop a planning function in line with increasing project workload and business growth.

· Experience operating successfully within a challenging, fast-moving environment with competing project priorities.

· Experience as a Senior Planner, Lead Planner or equivalent on complex construction projects.

· Strong working knowledge of Asta Powerproject.

· Ability to develop programmes from first principles rather than solely maintaining existing programmes.

· Strong understanding of critical path methodology, programme logic, float and schedule risk.

· Extensive working knowledge of NEC contracts.

· Strong understanding of the contractual role of the programme under NEC.

· Experience working under NEC Option B is highly desirable, including programme submissions, accepted programmes, Early Warnings, Compensation Events, revised programmes and assessment of time impacts.

· Ability to understand the interaction between programme, contractual obligations and commercial entitlement under NEC.

· Experience integrating design, procurement, construction, commissioning and handover activities.

· Strong understanding of construction sequencing and site delivery.

· Ability to challenge project teams and subcontractors constructively regarding programme performance.

· Strong analytical ability and the capability to identify emerging programme risks before they affect delivery.

· Experience developing mitigation and recovery programmes.

· Ability to interpret drawings, design information, procurement schedules and construction methodologies.

· Strong communication skills and the ability to present complex programme information clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

· Ability to manage a significant workload while maintaining visibility of priorities across the wider framework.

· Strong leadership and people-management capability, with the ability to establish expectations and maintain consistent standards across a planning team.

Desirable Experience

· Pharmaceutical or life-sciences facilities.

· Live operational manufacturing environments.

· Highly regulated construction environments.

· MEP-intensive projects.

· Complex refurbishment and brownfield projects.

· NEC Option B contracts within a framework environment.

· Projects involving frequent Early Warnings and Compensation Events.

· Projects involving planned shutdowns, isolations and restricted working windows.

· Multi-project capital investment programmes.

· Delay analysis and extension-of-time assessments.

· Growing or restructuring a planning team to support an expanding project portfolio

Qualifications

Required Qualifications and Training

  • Degree or equivalent qualification in Construction, Engineering or a related discipline.

  • Proven experience in planning complex construction projects.

  • Proficiency in planning software such as Primavera P6, Microsoft Project or similar.

Desirable Qualifications and Training

  • Membership of a recognised professional planning body (APM, PMI or equivalent).

  • Experience in integrating design, procurement and construction planning.

  • Knowledge of programme integration with BIM, cost and risk management systems.

Additional Information

  • Competitive salary
  • 26 days annual leave plus additional company days
  • Pension and benefits
  • Unlimited learning and development opportunities
  • Much more

Our People and Recruitment Commitment

At Sisk Group our people are at the heart of our success. We offer the chance to work with purpose, build a career with no limits and be part of a great team.

All vacancies are managed directly by our Internal Recruitment Team. Unsolicited contact or speculative CVs from unapproved agencies will not be accepted and no introductory fees will apply.

We are an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, disability, age, sexual orientation, religion or any other protected characteristic.

Reasonable adjustments are available during the recruitment process

We know the confidence gap and imposter phenomenon can stop talented candidates applying. You do not need to meet every criterion – your skills and potential matter. Don’t hold back we want to hear from you

All recruitment materials comply with legal and regulatory requirements including the EU Pay Transparency Directive and the Equality Acts UK and Ireland

title: UZ Brussel - Medical Application Expert
description:

Word onze nieuwe medical application expert op de afdeling ICT - application support team
UZ Brussel is een toonaangevend universitair ziekenhuis in het hart van onze hoofdstad. Wij zijn een warm en vooruitstrevend ziekenhuis waar innovatie, onderzoek en patiëntgerichte zorg hand in hand gaan. Je vormt de brug tussen zorg en IT en zorgt ervoor dat eindgebruikers efficiënt en correct met het EPD kunnen werken.
  • Je ondersteunt clinici, verpleegkundigen, paramedici en administratieve medewerkers bij vragen en problemen rond het elektronisch patiëntendossier Primuz.
  • Je coördineert de uitrol van nieuwe modules en functionaliteiten, van voorbereiding tot implementatie en nazorg.
  • Je organiseert opleidingen voor gebruikers binnen UZ Brussel en partnerziekenhuizen.
  • Je stelt handleidingen, release notes en functionele documentatie op.
  • Je analyseert incidenten en problemen en werkt hiervoor samen met ontwikkelteams.
  • Je beheert applicatieconfiguraties zoals gebruikersrollen, workflows en parameterinstellingen.
  • Je ondersteunt acceptatietesten en bewaakt de kwaliteit van nieuwe releases.
  • Je zorgt ervoor dat best practices worden gedeeld tussen verschillende ziekenhuizen.
  • Vanaf mediorniveau neem je functionele analyse-opdrachten op en vertaal je gebruikersnoden naar concrete oplossingen.
  • Je gebruikt technische hulpmiddelen zoals SQL, HL7 en andere integratietechnologieën om problemen te analyseren en op te lossen.

Welke collega zoeken we?

We zijn op zoek naar een enthousiaste Medical Application Expert die zichzelf herkent in volgende eigenschappen:
  • Passie voor digitale zorg: je hebt interesse in ziekenhuisprocessen, klinische workflows en innovatieve IT-oplossingen.
  • Relevante expertise: je hebt een achtergrond in gezondheidszorg-IT, biomedische informatica, verpleegkunde of een gelijkaardig domein.
  • Communicatief en klantgericht: je vertaalt complexe informatie helder naar eindgebruikers en vormt de brug tussen IT en zorg.
  • Analytisch, leergierig en oplossingsgericht: je pakt problemen gestructureerd aan en verdiept je graag in nieuwe technologieën.
  • Teamspeler met technische affiniteit: je neemt verantwoordelijkheid, werkt vlot samen en hebt bij voorkeur kennis van SQL. Kennis van HL7/FHIR is een troef.
  • Taalvaardig: Nederlands is de voertaal binnen UZ Brussel en je beheerst deze taal vlot. Kennis van Frans en/of Engels is een bijkomende troef.

They are at the crossroads of business and technology and engage with organizations at all stages of cloud adoption. Solutions Architects also take a leading role in creating and presenting technical content and best practices.

Solutions Architects own the overall technical relationship between customers and AWS. They work to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology.

In this role you will get to practice your creativity, linking technology to tangible solutions and educating AWS customers about the art of the possible. You will have the opportunity to define or invent cloud-native reference architectures for a variety of use cases. You will have the support to grow your expertise in software industry and technology areas of depth. Every day you will be learning something new from your customers, your peers and your own experiments.

At Amazon you will be encouraged and rewarded for doing what is right for the long-term success of the customer. We value your passion to discover, invent and build on behalf of customers.

Come build the future with us.

AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and unwavering support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.


Key job responsibilities
As a Solutions Architect, you will work directly with customers to accelerate their mission-critical projects and recommend best-practice architectures in line with their long-term business outcomes.

You will also:

* Educate customers of all sizes on the value proposition of AWS, and participate in deep architectural discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful deployment in the cloud.
* You will own the technical relationship with the customer and operate as their trusted advisor. The best interests of the customer will shape the guidance you provide. You will share the voice of the customer to influence the roadmap of new features and services for the AWS platform.

Evangelize and educate about AWS technology and industry trends (e.g. workshops, user groups, meetups, public speaking, online videos or conferences).
* Contribute to the growth of the Solutions Architecture organization by hiring, coaching and mentoring others.
* Develop areas of depth in technical domains relevant to your interests and your customer's outcomes.

A day in the life
You will have the opportunity to work with account managers to help ISV customers accelerate their cloud implementation to modernize their business on AWS. Working with these customers, you will help them transform existing workloads by designing modern target architectures optimized for business agility, innovation, performance, resiliency, cost, security, and more using both native and partner solutions.

Our teams focus on understanding customer key business drivers as well as the existing application architecture(s) to deliver a technical recommendation to the customer with a goal of designing a robust cloud architecture that can scale as their business requires.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.



The AWS ISV Solutions Architecture team is dedicated to working with software companies. We’re here to help customers to design and build some of the most scalable, flexible and resilient cloud architectures and solutions – cost efficiently to enable them to expand their business globally.

title: Senior Product Owner
description:
BUSUP

BUSUP is a global corporate mobility company helping organizations rethink how their people get to work. Through a technology-driven, asset-light model, we combine data, AI-powered route optimization, operational expertise, and a trusted network of local transport operators to make employee commuting more efficient, flexible, and sustainable.

We partner with large companies across Europe, Latin America, and North America to design, manage, and continuously improve shared mobility solutions that reduce costs, lower emissions, and create a better commuting experience for employees. At BUSUP, we believe the future of corporate mobility is smarter, more connected, and built around people, helping companies move their teams with greater efficiency, visibility, and impact.

FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

We are looking for a senior, proactive and decisive Product Owner with strong experience in discovery and validation, capable of working autonomously in environments of great uncertainty and constant change.

This person will lead the definition and validation of new product initiatives from the earliest stages — identifying problems, validating hypotheses with users and stakeholders, and turning insights into clear, actionable product decisions — while also managing the backlog and ensuring execution aligns with business objectives.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Discovery & Validation

  • Lead discovery processes to identify user needs, pain points, and opportunities.

  • Design and run validation techniques (user interviews, prototypes, A/B testing, focus groups) to test hypotheses before development.

  • Translate discovery findings into clear problem statements and product opportunities.

  • Ensure decisions are backed by data and qualitative/quantitative research, not assumptions.

2. Requirement Definition & Management

  • Analyze and refine BusUp initial project definitions, breaking them down into detailed functional and technical requirements.

  • Create and prioritize the Product Backlog in collaboration with internal stakeholders.

  • Write User Stories, acceptance criteria, and functional documentation.

  • Ensure all requirements are clear, feasible, and aligned with BusUp vision.

3. Development & Execution Management

  • Act as the primary point of contact between BusUp and development teams (internal and/or external).

  • Define and coordinate sprints or delivery phases, ensuring objectives are met on time.

  • Oversee project planning and execution, resolving blockers and facilitating key decisions.

  • Monitor progress, risks, and deviations from the product roadmap.

  • Ensure adherence to quality standards and acceptance criteria.

4. Communication & Reporting

  • Provide regular project updates to BusUp stakeholders.

  • Coordinate follow-up meetings (daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, etc.).

  • Manage expectations and maintain transparency in product/project evolution.

5. Validation & Delivery

  • Coordinate and validate functional testing with QA and stakeholders.

  • Ensure the final product meets validated user needs and defined requirements before delivery.

  • Facilitate proper knowledge transfer for future maintenance and scalability.

WHAT YOU BRING

Previous Experience:

  • 5+ years as a Product Owner or Product Manager in software/tech products, with a senior-level track record.

  • Solid, hands-on experience leading discovery and validation processes (not just backlog/delivery management).

  • Experience managing development teams (internal and/or external).

  • Background in mobility, transportation, or SaaS (preferred).

Key Skills:

  • Strong expertise in discovery techniques: user research, interviews, prototyping, hypothesis validation.

  • Ability to translate ambiguous, high-level problems into validated, detailed requirements.

  • Experience managing roadmaps and backlogs in tools like Jira, Trello, or similar.

  • Solid knowledge of Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and Waterfall when applicable.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, comfortable working across cultures/time zones.

  • Problem-solving mindset with the ability to make quick, autonomous decisions in dynamic environments.

  • Experience in UX/UI collaboration.

  • Experience in A/B testing and focus groups.

It would be a plus:

  • Experience as a programmer.

  • Computer science degree or similar.

  • Analytics tools experience.

  • Firebase.

Languages:

  • Fluent in Portuguese (Brazil) and English (both mandatory).

  • Spanish is nice to have.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Opportunity to lead strategic, high-impact discovery initiatives at BusUp.

  • Flexible work arrangements.

  • Senior-level ownership over product decisions with real impact on sustainable mobility.

BUSUP BENEFITS🎁

title: Teamleader till Ateas onsite-team i Karlstad
description:

Rollen handlar om att säkerställa en välfungerande leverans genom att leda det dagliga arbetet, koordinera teamets insatser och vara den naturliga länken mellan kund och tekniker. Du är en viktig ledare i vardagen som stöttar teamet, skapar struktur och bidrar till att arbetet drivs framåt mot gemensamma mål.

Teamet utgår huvudsakligen från Karlstad men levererar service till verksamheter runt om i länet. Du kommer att arbeta nära både kunden och dina kollegor inom Atea för att säkerställa en stabil, effektiv och kvalitativ leverans.

Exempel på arbetsuppgifter

Leda och koordinera det dagliga arbetet i teamet
Hantera operativa frågor från både team och kund
Fördela arbetsuppgifter och säkerställa rätt bemanning
Säkerställa att leveransen följer uppsatta servicenivåer
Planera och leda teammöten
Delta i kundmöten och vara en viktig kontaktperson i den dagliga dialogen
Stötta teamet i tekniska frågeställningar vid behov
Bidra till utveckling av arbetssätt, rutiner och samarbete

Vem söker vi?Vi söker dig som har ett genuint intresse för både människor och teknik. Du motiveras av att få andra att lyckas, trivs med att ta ansvar i vardagen och har en naturlig förmåga att skapa engagemang och framdrift i en grupp.

För att trivas och lyckas i rollen behöver du uppskatta ledarskap i vardagen och tycka om att skapa förutsättningar för andra att lyckas. Du känner dig bekväm med att ta initiativ, fatta beslut och driva frågor framåt när situationen kräver det. Genom ett tydligt och närvarande sätt skapar du förtroende hos både teamet och kunden. Samtidigt har du tillräcklig teknisk förståelse för att kunna stötta teamet och föra dialog i tekniska frågor.

Vi tror att du idag arbetar som exempelvis onsite-tekniker, supporttekniker, servicetekniker, teknisk samordnare eller i en annan kundnära IT-roll och vill ta nästa steg i din utveckling.

För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har

Erfarenhet från IT-support, onsite-support eller annan kundnära IT-roll
God kunskap i Windows Enterprise-miljö
Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift
B-körkort

Det är meriterande om du även har

Erfarenhet av att leda eller samordna ett team
Erfarenhet av Intune och/eller SCCM

Därför ska du välja AteaHos oss präglas kulturen av samarbete, utveckling och engagemang. Vi arbetar utifrån visionen att vara "The Place To Be" – en arbetsplats där människor trivs, utvecklas och lyckas tillsammans.

I den här rollen får du möjlighet att utvecklas inom ledarskap samtidigt som du behåller kopplingen till tekniken. Du får en nyckelroll i ett av Ateas viktigaste kunduppdrag i Värmland och ett brett kontaktnät inom både Atea och kundens organisation.

För att ge dig bästa möjliga start finns nuvarande Teamleader kvar under övergångsperioden och bidrar till en trygg introduktion i rollen.

ÖvrigtTjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid hos Atea, med start enligt överenskommelse. Du utgår från Karlstad och arbetar huvudsakligen tillsammans med teamet i kundens verksamhet.

Välkommen med din ansökan senast den 25 oktober 2026. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, vilket innebär att tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag. Vi rekommenderar därför att du skickar in din ansökan så snart som möjligt.

Samtliga ansökningar hanteras digitalt. Vi tar inte emot ansökningar via e-post eller post.

title: Senior AI Engineer - AI Platform & ML Engineering IT-26-229

The Opportunity:

We’re looking for an AI Engineer, AI Platform & ML Engineering to join our Data & AI Technology Partners team. Reporting to the Sr. Director of Data Science and AI Enablement, the AI Platform & ML Engineering is responsible for focusing on the platform patterns, MLOps practices, model lifecycle, deployment standards, monitoring, evaluation, and governance integration needed to move AI and machine learning solutions beyond experimentation. This is a hands‑on engineering role for someone who wants to build the foundation that allows AI solutions to become repeatable, governed, observable, and production ready.

  • We Care – You do the right thing for clients, partners and colleagues. You build trusted relationships, champion service excellence, and contribute to a culture where people feel valued and supported

  • Build reusable AI and ML engineering patterns that help teams move from proof‑of‑value to production safely and consistently
  • Establish practical MLOps and LLMOps practices using Databricks, AWS, MLflow and related platform capabilities
  • Create standards and templates for model deployment, serving, monitoring, evaluation, and production release
  • Support API integration and deployment patterns for ML, GenAI and agentic solutions

  • Help monitor AI cost, performance, reliability, usage, and operational risk, while contributing to reusable standards and community learning

Requirements

Your experience and skills:

  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering or related technical field
  • Equivalent hands‑on experience building data, AI, machine learning, platform, or cloud engineering solutions may be considered in place of formal education
  • 10+ years of overall experience with 4+ years of experience building, deploying, or supporting machine learning, AI, or data‑driven solutions in production environments and 5 to 7 years working in the data space
  • Databricks certification related to Machine Learning, Data Engineering, Generative AI or platform administration
  • AWS certifications related to cloud architecture, machine learning, AI, DevOps, data engineering or security
  • Microsoft Azure certifications related to AI, data, cloud engineering, DevOps, or security
  • Other relevant certifications in MLOps, LLMOps, cloud platforms, DevOps, security, architecture, or enterprise AI platforms
  • Strong Python development skills, especially for ML engineering, automation, APIs, testing and production implementation
  • Hands‑on experience with cloud‑based AI/ML platforms; experience with AWS an asset, Databricks, Azure, MLflow or Lakehouse platforms
  • Strong understanding of MLOps, CI/CD/CT, model deployment, model serving, and production release practices for AI and ML solutions
  • Experience with model evaluation, validation, monitoring and observability, including model performance, drift, reliability, latency, usage and cost
  • Familiarity with LLMOps practices that support GenAI and agentic solutions in production, including prompt/model versioning, evaluation pipelines, controlled releases, and production support patterns
  • Experience developing reusable AI/ML platform patterns, including deployment templates, secure serving patterns, feature engineering standards, and integration frameworks
  • Understanding of enterprise security, governance, and control requirements for production AI and ML workloads
  • Strong consultative and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical trade‑offs to data, technology, risk, governance, and business stakeholders
  • Fluent communication skills in English are required and bilingual skills in French are an asset

Benefits

Why Aviso Wealth?

At Aviso Wealth, you will find a dynamic and inclusive culture that rewards innovation and celebrates success. Here are a few things that set us apart:

  • Competitive compensation package that rewards and recognizes individual contributions
  • Excellent health, dental and insurance benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees
  • Generous vacation time, fitness benefit, parental leave top‑up options
  • Matching contributions to our retirement program
  • Commitment to the continuous improvement of our staff through learning & development and an education assistance program
  • Regular social events to foster teamwork

Your Information

By submitting your application, you consent to the collection, use, and disclosure of your provided personal information for the purposes of assessing your qualifications and suitability for employment with Aviso. Your information will be handled in accordance with applicable Canadian privacy laws, including the Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA) and relevant provincial legislation. Your data may be shared with authorized personnel involved in the recruitment process and retained only as long as necessary to fulfill these purposes or as required by law.

Further information is available on the Privacy link on our Career Page -Privacy Policies

Equal Employment Opportunity

Aviso welcomes and encourages applications from all qualified individuals including persons with disabilities. If you require an accommodation, we will work with you to meet your needs in all stages of the hiring process.

We thank all applicants for their interest, however, only those selected for further consideration will be contacted.

No recruiters or agencies, please.

Company Overview:

Aviso is a leading wealth management and investment services provider for the Canadian financial industry, with approximately $145 billion in total assets under administration and management, and over 1,000 employees. We're building a comprehensive, technology-enabled, client‑centric wealth services ecosystem. Our clients include our partners, advisors, and investors. We're a trusted partner for nearly all credit unions across Canada, in addition to a wide range of portfolio managers, investment dealers, insurance and trust companies, and introducing brokers. Our partners depend on Aviso for specific solutions that give them a competitive edge in a rapidly evolving, highly competitive industry. Our investment dealer and mutual fund dealer and our insurance services support thousands of investment advisors. Our asset manager, NEI Investments, specializes in investing responsibly. Our online brokerage, Qtrade Direct Investing®, empowers self‑directed investors, and our fully automated investing service, Qtrade Guided Portfolios®, serves investors who prefer a hands‑off approach. Aviso Correspondent Partners provides custodial and carrying broker services to a wide range of firms. We have offices in Toronto, Vancouver, and Montreal. Aviso is backed by the collective strength of our owners: the credit union Centrals, Co‑operators/CUMIS, and Desjardins.We're proud to power businesses that empower investors.

A career with Aviso means being part of a group of talented, energetic professionals who live their values every day, and belonging to an organization dedicated to your success and career development. If you're looking for interesting and challenging work, at a company committed to its people, we look forward to hearing from you.

title: Private Lacrosse Coach
location: West Palm Beach, Florida, United States
description:
Coach lacrosse on your own schedule in West Palm Beach, Florida.

STXZ Lacrosse has 1 opening(s) for independent lacrosse coaches in the West Palm Beach area, to cover client requests for private lessons we can't currently fill. We bring you the clients. You run the sessions.

About STXZ

STXZ is a technology platform that connects families with independent lacrosse coaches across the United States. We send you clients in your area, handle the administrative work, and get out of your way so you can coach. If you have lacrosse experience and want coaching work on a flexible schedule, this is for you.

How it works

When a family near West Palm Beach requests lessons through STXZ, we send you a client offer with the details. You review it and decide whether to take it. No quotas, no pressure, no penalty for declining.

When you accept:

  • You contact the client directly within 24 hours
  • You and the client agree on schedule and location: their home, a local field, a park, your call
  • You run the session your way. Drills, pacing, and structure are your professional judgment
  • You submit a quick lesson briefing on the platform after the session
  • You get paid

STXZ never tells you how to coach, what drills to use, or how to structure your lessons.

What you earn

  • $35 to $50 per one-hour session, paid as a flat per-lesson rate. Rates are set by STXZ, vary by market and demand, and are confirmed in writing before your first lesson.
  • Payout within 24 to 48 hours after you submit your lesson briefing, via PayPal
  • 1099-NEC issued at year end if you earn $2,000 or more through the platform
  • Paid per completed session. Lesson volume depends on client demand in your area, and STXZ does not guarantee a minimum number of lessons.
  • No fee to apply, and nothing to pay up front

Schedule

Most lessons run weekday afternoons and evenings and on weekends. Work when you want and pause your availability anytime.

What you control

  • Your schedule. Accept or decline every offer without penalty or impact on your standing.
  • Your methods. Drills, lesson plans, teaching style, all yours.
  • Your territory. Set your own travel radius, from a few miles to 35 or more.
  • Your approach. You decide what equipment to bring to each session.

What STXZ handles

  • Client acquisition. We market the platform and bring families to you.
  • Matching. We send you local client offers that fit your profile.
  • Payment processing. We collect from clients and pay you after each session.
  • Billing, refunds, and disputes. Our support team handles all of it. You coach.
  • Liability coverage. Active coaches are enrolled in STXZ's platform liability coverage program for sessions booked through STXZ. The program fee is $30 per year, and it is $0 down: nothing is due to get started or to begin receiving client offers. The fee is recovered from your first lesson payout once you start coaching. This is limited coverage for platform-booked sessions only; independent coaches may also choose to carry their own personal insurance.

Who this is for

  • Coaching experience at the youth, high school, club, or college level, or playing experience at the high school varsity, club, college, or professional level
  • 18 or older
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States
  • Willing to complete a third-party background check, arranged by STXZ, before receiving full client details
  • Reliable transportation to training locations in your area
  • Your own stick and basic training equipment: cones, balls, training aids
  • Strong communication with parents, players, and the STXZ team
  • Professionalism and confidence working independently with families and youth athletes

How to apply

Apply here (about 2 minutes). If your background fits, we send a short coaching profile questionnaire: playing history, coaching experience, positions, availability. After review and background screening, approved coaches start receiving local client offers.

STXZ is a technology platform that connects clients with independent lacrosse coaches. STXZ does not employ, supervise, manage, or control coaches or their training sessions. Coaches are engaged as independent contractors and are responsible for their own coaching methods, taxes, and scheduling. STXZ considers all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

What you’ll do

· Improving and simplifing our Continuous Integration systems and pipelines.

· Contributing to the applications to improve how they leverage current Azure services, or adopt new Azure services, to reduce the maintenance cost.

· You are a Platform Engineer, DevOps Engineer, or Site Reliability Engineer with 3+ years of experience supporting a .NET/C# and Windows stack for SaaS services. Or,

· You are a .NET/C# developer with 3+ years of experience, with an affinity for cloud infrastructure and at least a year of experience running and operating Windows systems to host SaaS services.

· You have worked with infrastructure in cloud environments before. We use Azure, but experience with AWS or GCP is welcome too.

· You’re familiar with tools like terraform, Ansible, PowerShell, Azure Machine Configuration (or equivalent) etc.

· You have some familiarity with Linux systems and running containers.

· You have an interest in the security of our systems and infrastructure.

· You have a product mindset, seeing the infrastructure and our tooling as services we offer to other teams.

· You are self-driven and can figure things out on your own with some support from others.

What do we offer you?

We are proud to offer you a workplace where we have high engagement and where creativity and curiosity is always much appreciated. Your ideas will be heard.

title: Inventory Planner
description:
The Capacity Planning Team provides Amazon Operations with cost-optimal and flexible capacity solutions for operational activities year-round, enabling the business to scale for seasonal peak demand increases. This role is based out of our corporate office. The ideal candidate is passionate about leveraging data to deliver actionable insights that impact daily business, has a strong delivery record, and is experienced in driving execution in a cross-functional environment, backed by analysis and data. They thrive in a fast-paced environment, relish working with large amounts of data, and enjoy the challenge of solving highly complex, and sometimes ambiguous problems.

Key job responsibilities
In this position, you will take ownership of capacity planning from day one, exercising sound judgment to ensure plans are realistic and achievable. At Amazon, we trust our people and provide extensive support to help set you up for success. Our culture is learn-by-doing oriented, empowering you to take control of your career.

A day in the life
As a Planning Analyst in the Capacity Planning Team, your daily responsibilities will center around generating and maintaining data-driven capacity plans to ensure operational efficiency. You will start your day by reviewing performance metrics and analyzing any execution gaps from previous plans, using these insights to refine future forecasts. Throughout the day, you'll collaborate with cross-functional partners to align on resource requirements and implementation strategies. You will spend time diving deep into data analysis, using tools like SQL and Excel to extract meaningful patterns and trends that inform your planning decisions. Regular stakeholder meetings will be part of your routine, where you'll present your findings and recommendations to key business partners. Your role will also involve continuously monitoring planning accuracy, identifying improvement opportunities, and implementing solutions to enhance the planning process. Working in this dynamic environment, you'll need to remain flexible and ready to respond to changing business needs while maintaining focus on long-term strategic planning objectives.

title: AI Software & Platform Engineer
description:
AI Software & Platform Engineer


Location: Toronto, Canada (Remote)

Experience : 4-8 Years

About LatentView

LatentView Analytics is a global data analytics and AI solutions company that partners with Fortune 500 and high-growth clients to turn data into competitive advantage. Our teams combine deep technical expertise with business context to ship measurable outcomes — not just models and dashboards — across industries.


Role Overview

We are looking for an AI Software & Platform Engineer to help build, deploy, operate, and integrate AI-powered applications and services.


The ideal candidate is a strong software/platform engineer with significant hands-on experience in Python, Kubernetes, Docker, backend systems, and production environments. The role sits at the intersection of software engineering, platform engineering, AI infrastructure, and data engineering. We are therefore looking for engineers with strong technical fundamentals who can learn new technologies quickly and adapt their skills as project requirements evolve.


Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain backend services supporting AI-powered applications.
  • Develop APIs and integrations between applications, services, and data systems.
  • Containerize and deploy applications using Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Develop and maintain CI/CD workflows.
  • Support application deployment, monitoring, reliability, and troubleshooting.
  • Work with engineering teams to improve scalability, reliability, and operational efficiency.
  • Integrate AI agents and LLM-powered applications with backend services and data sources.
  • Develop and maintain data integrations and pipelines as project needs evolve.
  • Troubleshoot issues across application, infrastructure, and data layers.
  • Contribute to engineering standards, automation, and operational best practices.
  • Learn new technologies, frameworks, and platforms as required.


Required Skills

Software Engineering

  • 4–10 years of professional engineering experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Python.
  • Experience developing backend services and APIs.
  • Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals.
  • Experience with:
  • Git
  • Testing
  • Debugging
  • API development
  • Production software
  • System integration

Platform Engineering

  • Strong hands-on Kubernetes experience.
  • Strong experience with Docker and containerized applications.
  • Experience deploying and operating production applications.
  • Good understanding of:
  • Kubernetes workloads
  • Deployments
  • Services
  • Configuration
  • Resource management
  • Troubleshooting
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines.
  • Familiarity with monitoring, logging, and observability.

AI / Agent Exposure

Hands-on experience with or familiarity with:

  • LLM applications
  • AI agents
  • RAG
  • Tool/function calling
  • AI application deployment

Data Engineering Fundamentals

  • Strong SQL skills.
  • Experience working with structured and semi-structured data.
  • Understanding of ETL/ELT concepts.
  • Experience building, maintaining, or supporting data pipelines.
  • Understanding of databases and data integration.

Preferred Skills

  • Kubernetes at scale
  • Infrastructure as Code
  • Terraform or equivalent
  • Distributed systems
  • Microservices
  • Workflow orchestration
  • Cloud platforms
  • Data processing frameworks
  • Event-driven architectures
  • Streaming technologies
  • Observability and tracing
  • Security and IAM
  • AI/ML infrastructure
  • Agent orchestration frameworks

What We Value

Strong Learning Agility

The role will involve technologies and systems that candidates may not have previously encountered.

We are looking for engineers who can:

  • Quickly understand unfamiliar technical environments.
  • Learn new infrastructure and deployment technologies.
  • Transfer experience from existing platforms to new environments.
  • Work independently through technical documentation.
  • Troubleshoot complex production problems.
  • Develop new skills as the team's needs evolve.
  • Transition across software, platform, AI, and data engineering responsibilities when required.


Base pay range: $126,000 CAD – $144,000 CAD annually. This range reflects base salary only — it excludes Incentive and benefits — and is a good-faith estimate for this level and location that may vary based on experience, skills, and where the role is performed.


Communication: This role requires fluent spoken and written English to communicate directly with client stakeholders — a job-related requirement of the client-facing work itself, not of any candidate's background or origin.

The Grab Financial Services Analytics team supports the Financial Services product and business organisations, across Payments, Lending, Insurance, and Kios. Our team focuses on understanding user experiences and partners with Business, Product, Design, and Tech teams to achieve the right outcomes. We are necessary to product development, from understanding user journeys with UX designers, to developing hypotheses, through to post-rollout optimisation.

Get to Know the Role

You will use data to understand user needs and be the de-facto Voice of the Customer (users, driver-partners, merchants, agents) across Lending's suite of products. You will use data to unveil insights to help scale our products. You will promote data-driven decision-making within GFin and partner with Product Managers, Business Owners, UX Designers, and Engineers to design analytical projects that inform the Product roadmap. You will provide expertise and produce data-driven hypotheses to solve important Product and Business problems, and guide our Financial Services strategies forward.

You will report into the Lending Analytics Manager and work onsite at our office in Petaling Jaya, Malaysia.

  • You will partner with product, design, and engineering teams to obtain insights, design experiments, and guide important product decisions.
  • You will support strategic plans with data insights, performing deep-dives into user behaviour, segmented views and product efficacy.
  • You will provide tailored analysis for specific products and strategies, define critical business and product metrics, and make regular recommendations for continuous improvements.
  • You will design, measure, and recommend A/B tests and multivariate experiments, including layout optimisation, UI/UX efficacy, algorithm effectiveness, and API performance.
  • You will analyse clickstream and transactional data to uncover insights on user behaviour and guide product metrics. You will manage instrumentation for all feature releases within assigned tech families within GFin.
  • You will develop self-serve solutions for partners that are scalable and automated to handle a product environment. You will guide plans involving Large Language Models or Generative Artificial Intelligence.

What Essential Skills You Will Need

  • You have at least 4 years of experience in Analytics, Business Intelligence, or Data Science, in a Tech (FinTech or E-Commerce) company.
  • You have a Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Analytics, Economics, Mathematics, Engineering, or related fields.
  • You are proficient in writing advanced SQL queries and querying large relational databases.
  • You have hands-on experience with data analysis and programming tools such as Python.
  • You are skilled in data visualisation platforms like PowerBI or D3.js to present findings.
  • You have experience designing, running, and analysing A/B tests and product experiments, with knowledge of hypothesis testing and the basic principles of Design of Experiments (DoE).

The Quality Assurance Team Leader supports the implementation and monitoring of food safety, quality, and hygiene standards in QACC. The role assists in ensuring that food production, handling, storage, and dispatch activities comply with company procedures, customer requirements, and applicable regulatory standards. The position coordinates routine QA checks, supports inspections and audits, promotes Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and HACCP compliance, and helps maintain high standards of food safety and product quality while developing supervisory and leadership capabilities within the operation, keeping key accountability of the enhancement of Food Safety Culture.

  • Assist in maintaining QA documentation, records, checklists, and traceability systems in line with company and customer requirements.

  • Monitor pest control, sanitation, and cleaning activities to ensure compliance with established standards.

  • Assist in investigating customer complaints, operational incidents, and quality-related issues.

  • Promote a culture of continuous improvement, food safety awareness, and compliance within the department.

  • Ensure compliance with company policies, occupational health & safety requirements, and aviation catering standards.

  • Support environmental sustainability initiatives by promoting waste reduction, resource conservation, and recycling practices in line with environmental sustainability requirements.

  • Support business continuity planning activities by assisting in the implementation of contingency procedures and ensuring operational readiness during disruptions or emergencies.

  • Perform other department duties related to the position as directed by the Head of the Department.

  • Promote and support the enhancement of food safety culture across the operation.

title: Chief Growth Officer, Multi Asset CFD Broker, Dubai
description:
Emerald Zebra on behalf of our client, a regulated multi-asset CFD broker, is looking to hire a Chief Growth Officer, to be based in Dubai, UAE. Reporting to the CEO, this is a senior leadership role with full ownership of the retail sales business across MENA, Asia, LATAM and other emerging markets.

The company

Our client is a regulated multi-asset CFD broker offering professional grade execution to Professional retail and Institutional clients globally. Clients trade Forex, Indices, Commodities, Shares, ETFs, Crypto, Futures and Options through MetaTrader 5, institutional grade third party platforms and a proprietary trading terminal, supported by STP and aggregation order routing, segregated client funds and a native copy trading offering. The business is scaling rapidly across MENA, Asia and emerging markets.

The role

As Chief Growth Officer, you will define and execute the commercial strategy for the retail and institutional trading business and lead a multi-desk, multi-language sales organisation responsible for client acquisition, conversion, retention and revenue growth across the Professional trader segment. You will own sales performance, team management, budgeting, commission design and strategic planning, working closely with Marketing, Onboarding, Compliance, Dealing, Product and the Institutional team to turn execution quality into measurable funded account and trading volume growth.

Sales strategy and revenue ownership

  • Own the retail sales strategy, forecasting model and full P&L for funded accounts, deposits and trading volume revenue across all trading platforms
  • Set, cascade and deliver quarterly and annual revenue targets across regional desks in MENA, Asia, LATAM and other emerging markets
  • Drive pipeline quality, lead to funded conversion, average deposit, and retention and reactivation metrics across the full client lifecycle
  • Lead negotiations and personally support the closing of high value Professional and VIP accounts
  • Build the commercial case for entering new markets, launching new account tiers and expanding the multi-asset CFD product set

Team leadership and development

  • Build, lead and scale a multi-language retail sales organisation of Sales Managers, Senior Account Managers, Business Development Managers and Retention and Dealing Desk specialists
  • Set clear KPIs, performance standards and career progression paths across the sales floor
  • Coach and mentor the team, run structured pipeline reviews, and uplift negotiation, product and platform demo capability
  • Design and refine the commission, bonus and appraisal structure so individual incentives align with quality revenue, retention and compliance outcomes
  • Recruit against growth plans, with a strong bias for multilingual talent in English, Arabic and regional languages

Client relationships and VIP management

  • Own and grow relationships with key Professional and VIP clients, IBs, affiliates and high net worth traders
  • Personally support Senior Account Managers on complex, strategic or sensitive cases
  • Prepare tailored proposals, fee structures and execution quality reports based on client trading behaviour, asset preferences and platform usage
  • Represent the business at industry events, expos, partner roadshows and client forums across the regional hubs

Working across the business

  • Partner with Marketing on acquisition campaigns, lead quality scoring and conversion funnel optimisation
  • Work with Onboarding, KYC and Compliance to deliver smooth, regulator grade client journeys across current and future licensing jurisdictions
  • Feed platform insight to Product and Technology and prioritise enhancements that move sales metrics
  • Align with the Institutional team on the hand off of clients who graduate from Professional to Institutional offerings

Operations, reporting and governance

  • Oversee CRM discipline, sales operations and end to end reporting on activity, pipeline, conversion and revenue
  • Provide structured market, client and competitor insight to the executive team
  • Ensure all sales activity meets regulatory requirements, internal compliance standards, the order execution policy and risk disclosure obligations
  • Manage the sales cost base, including headcount, commissions, travel and events, within agreed budgets

What you bring

  • 8+ years of sales experience in online brokerage, CFDs, FX, multi-asset trading or financial services, with material exposure to retail and Professional trader segments
  • 4+ years leading sales teams of 10+ people, ideally across multiple regional desks in MENA, Asia or LATAM
  • A demonstrable track record of delivering revenue, funded account and deposit targets in a regulated brokerage environment
  • Hands on experience scaling a sales floor through hyper growth, including hiring, onboarding and ramping multilingual sales talent
  • In depth knowledge of CFDs, leverage, margin and the OTC derivatives landscape across Forex, Indices, Commodities, Shares, ETFs, Crypto, Futures and Options
  • Strong working knowledge of MetaTrader 5 and professional trading terminals, with the credibility to demo execution quality, charting and automation features
  • Understanding of execution quality concepts including STP and aggregation, latency and slippage, and copy trading mechanics, and how they translate into a sales narrative
  • A solid grasp of regulatory expectations around retail CFD distribution, including risk disclosure and appropriateness
  • Strong commercial leadership, negotiation and stakeholder management skills, and comfort owning forecasts, conversion funnels, cohort retention and unit economics
  • Fluent English is required. Fluent Arabic is strongly preferred, and Mandarin, Hindi, Spanish or Russian are an advantage

Proven success building and managing IB, affiliate and partner channels is a strong plus.

You will be proactive, confident and results driven, able to keep teams calm and focused in volatile markets, and equally at home closing a VIP on the sales floor and defending a quarterly plan in the boardroom.

What is on offer

  • Salary up to USD 200,000 per annum, plus a quarterly performance based commission and bonus scheme tied to revenue and growth milestones
  • Premium family medical insurance
  • Annual return tickets to home country for the employee and immediate family, where applicable
  • 25 working days annual leave plus public holidays
  • Relocation support for international hires
  • Flexible working arrangements
  • Direct ownership of sales strategy and the opportunity to shape the retail business at a formative stage

To apply, send your CV via this advert with a short note on the largest sales team you have led, the revenue you owned and the markets you scaled it in. All applications are handled in confidence.

Donna Stephenson, Founder and Principal Recruiter, Emerald Zebra, specialist recruitment and executive search.

title: AI Modelling and Simulation Engineer
description:
The Opportunity

Lumai is moving from breakthrough optical-compute research to production AI systems. We need an engineer to build the performance and power modelling capability that guides architecture and compiler decisions before silicon exists, helping us turn a working system into a competitive product.

The Role

You will own the performance and power modelling framework that predicts how Lumai’s photonic AI hardware will perform against real inference workloads. Your models will give architecture and compiler teams a shared source of truth for latency, throughput and power across hardware configurations.

The hard part is balancing speed, fidelity and usability: you will model concurrency, event-driven behaviour and compute-block latency at enough detail to support decisions, while keeping simulations fast enough to compare configurations in minutes. You will characterise operator-level workloads against hardware, RTL or emulation results so the model stays grounded in evidence.

By month six, you will have established a reliable modelling flow for priority workloads and device configurations, demonstrated a clear path for closing gaps between model and hardware, and made the simulator a tool that architecture and compiler teams use to make decisions. You will report to the Head of Architecture or VP Engineering and may build and lead a small team around this capability.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build and maintain a Python-based framework that models hardware and software latency, hardware concurrency and event-driven relationships.

  • Model compute engines, interconnect and synchronisation fabric, memory and bridge interfaces, and accelerator blocks across device configurations.

  • Characterise convolution, depthwise convolution, pooling, attention and other operator workloads against hardware, RTL or emulation results.

  • Build compiler-agnostic interfaces that ingest compiled models and MLIR from multiple internal compiler flows.

  • Analyse simulation traces with architecture and compiler teams to improve layer-to-hardware mappings and resolve performance discrepancies.

  • Run industry benchmarks and representative models, including UL Procyon, Geekbench AI, Stable Diffusion and contemporary LLMs, to produce decision-ready KPIs.

  • Develop block-level power models and validate worst-case power scenarios with micro-architecture, verification and physical-design teams.

  • Own the CI/CD pipelines and simulation flows that keep results reliable and reproducible as usage scales.

  • Translate modelling findings into architecture and compiler decisions, while setting technical direction and developing engineers or interns as the team grows.

What We're Looking For

Must-have

  • Proven experience building or substantially extending a hardware/software performance-modelling or simulation framework for AI/ML accelerators, ideally in Python.

  • Strong understanding of hardware concurrency, event-driven modelling, and AI inference accelerator micro-architecture, including compute, memory hierarchy, interconnect and dataflow.

  • Hands-on experience characterising AI operators and correlating model predictions with real hardware or hardware-accurate reference data.

  • Familiarity with compiler internals and intermediate representations such as MLIR, including tooling that consumes compiler output to drive simulation.

  • Strong software-engineering and technical-leadership practice, including framework design, CI/CD ownership and direction or review of work by junior engineers or interns.

Strong preference for

  • Direct experience with NPU, GPU or other edge or client AI inference accelerator architectures.

  • Experience working across multiple compiler toolchains and reconciling architecture-level and production compiler behaviour.

  • Exposure to power modelling, RTL, emulation, FPGA prototyping, photonic compute or another non-traditional compute architecture.

About Lumai

Lumai is the optical compute company building the next generation of AI infrastructure. Spun out of optics research at the University of Oxford in 2021, we compute with light instead of electrons. Our 3D optical technology carries out the matrix multiplications at the heart of AI inside beams of light travelling through free space, which lets it go beyond the limits of both silicon GPUs and integrated photonics.

In April 2026 we launched Iris Nova, the world's first optical computing system to run billion-parameter large language models in real time, using up to 90% less energy than conventional GPU-based systems. Iris Nova, the first server in the family, is now available for evaluation by hyperscalers, neoclouds, enterprises and research institutions. Aura and Tetra will follow.

Our work won the Falling Walls Award for Science Breakthrough of the Year 2025 and 'Best Overall Technology' at the OCP Future Technologies Symposium. We are headquartered in Oxford.

Why Lumai

You'll work on a new kind of computer. Optical computing for AI has been promised for decades. We have a working system running real models, and the hard part left is taking it to volume.

Your work ships. We are moving from first product to volume production, so what you build this year goes into the servers our customers run.

You'll work across disciplines. Optical engineers, machine learning researchers, and hardware and software engineers solve problems together. You will learn things that don't appear on your job description.

The work matters beyond Lumai. AI's appetite for energy is one of the defining constraints of the next decade. Our mission is sustainable intelligence at global scale: AI that is faster, cheaper to run and far less power-hungry.

You'll join early. You'll have a real say in how we build the product, the team and the way we work.

Equal Opportunity

Lumai is an equal opportunity employer. We make hiring decisions based on skills, experience and potential, and we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. If you need an adjustment at any stage of the hiring process, let us know and we will do our best to support you.

Job Description

Description

Principal Data Scientist - Optimization Engineering

We are easyJet – a FTSE-250 listed, £multi-billion low-cost airline that serves tens of millions of customers every single year. If you’re reading this, you have probably already been an easyJet customer, and you’ll know that there is no more iconic (or Orange!) travel brand in Europe.

We fly more than 1,207 routes, connecting 38 countries across Europe, and employ more than 18,000 colleagues. We’re on a mission to make low-cost travel easy – and whatever your role here, you’ll connect millions of people to what they love using Europe’s best airline network, great value fares, and friendly service.

What makes us easyJet? Our Promise Behaviours – we are Safe, Bold, Welcoming and Challenging. Four Behaviours. One Spirit. One easyJet.

Role summary

Lead an optimisation engineering team building decision-support products that solve complex disruption-management and crew/roster optimisation challenges. You’ll translate operational problems into scalable software and optimisation solutions, partnering closely with product, data/operations research (OR), and customer stakeholders. The role blends people leadership with hands‑on technical direction across architecture, delivery, quality, and reliability.

Requirements of the Role

Key responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and grow a cross‑functional team of software engineers (and closely partnered OR/data science specialists)
  • Own technical direction and delivery for products that model, optimise, and operationalise solutions to disruption and crewing problems (e.g., recovery planning, re‑optimisation, what‑if analysis).
  • Drive architecture and design decisions for services, APIs, data pipelines, and user‑facing workflows that support optimisation at scale.
  • Partner with product management to shape roadmap, break down ambiguous problem statements, and define measurable outcomes and acceptance criteria.
  • Collaborate with OR/optimisation experts to integrate solvers (e.g., Gurobi) and ensure model performance, correctness, explainability, and maintainability.
  • Establish strong engineering practices: code review, automated testing, CI/CD, release management, incident response, and post‑incident learning.
  • Build observability into optimisation services (KPIs, logs, traces) and manage performance tuning (latency, throughput, cost) across environments.
  • Contribute hands‑on when needed (prototyping, critical‑path coding, reviews), while primarily enabling the team to deliver consistently.

Required qualifications

  • Proven experience leading a software engineering team delivering production‑grade systems (people leadership and/or strong technical leadership), that encompass solver technology (like CPLEX or Gurobi).
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals: system design, distributed systems concepts, APIs, data modelling, testing, and operational excellence.
  • Experience building optimisation, scheduling, or decision‑support applications, or closely related domains requiring complex constraint‑based reasoning.
  • Working knowledge of mathematical optimisation concepts (e.g., MILP, constraint programming, heuristics/metaheuristics) and how they impact product design.
  • Hands‑on programming experience in one or more mainstream languages (e.g., Python, Java, C#, C++), with the ability to review and guide code quality.
  • Experience integrating and operating optimisation components (e.g., solver orchestration, model/service boundaries, runtime configuration, fallbacks).
  • Ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non‑technical stakeholders, and to translate operational needs into engineering deliverables.

Preferred qualifications

  • Deep experience with commercial optimisation solvers (e.g., Gurobi), including parameter tuning, licensing/packaging considerations, and performance troubleshooting.
  • Experience in airline/rail/transport operations, logistics, workforce management, or similar disruption/crew scheduling environments.
  • Familiarity with simulation and scenario generation to support what‑if analysis and resilience planning.
  • Experience designing human‑in‑the‑loop decision tools (explainability, constraints override, auditability, and traceable recommendations).
  • Cloud platform experience (Azure/AWS/GCP) and building secure, scalable services.
  • Experience with event‑driven architectures, streaming, and near‑real‑time optimisation.
  • Experience with data science/ML components that complement optimisation (forecasting, demand estimation, delay prediction).

Technical skills & tools

Optimisation: Gurobi (or equivalent), model libraries/APIs, batching/warm starts, parameter management, sensitivity analysis.

  • Languages: Python and/or Java/C#/C++ (based on team stack).
  • Services: REST/gRPC APIs, microservices and/or modular monoliths, asynchronous job orchestration.
  • Data: SQL, data pipelines/ETL/ELT, caching strategies, data quality checks, reproducible inputs/outputs.
  • DevOps: CI/CD, infrastructure as code, containerisation (e.g., Docker), monitoring/alerting, incident management.
  • Quality: unit/integration tests, performance tests, model validation frameworks, feature flags.

Location & Hours of Work

We operate a hybrid working policy of 40%–60% of the month spent with colleagues.
