title: Engagement Manager
description:
Sana is an AI lab building superintelligence for work.

We believe organizations can accomplish their missions faster when humans can effortlessly access knowledge, automate repetitive work, and learn anything with the help of agentic AI.

As part of Workday, we are committed to building AI that augments humans.

If that’s a mission that excites you, you’re in the right place.

About the Role

We believe that everything starts with learning. And that by changing the way the world learns, we can change the world for the better. If that’s a mission that excites you, you’ll be in great company as part of the Sana team in Workday.

The Sana team is known for its adaptability, entrepreneurial spirit, and relentless pursuit of excellence, embodying our core belief that learning is the foundation of all meaningful change.

We work very closely with the companies who choose Sana. Together we problem solve, design solutions and implement them to drive change. Ultimately we measure ourselves through the impact we achieve through rolling out and adopting Sana. Our challenges are to continually learn and adapt to meet the unique needs of each company and team, and implement the creative solutions that make us proud of what we have achieved. While doing so we define what the future Sana's customer success, solution engineering and deployments teams will look like. By scaling this team, we create a significant impact on how people learn, across every industry, and across the globe.

In this role, you will:

Own end-to-end customer engagements

Serve as the overall engagement owner for assigned accounts, accountable for successful implementation and ongoing value realisation.
Lead complex deployments of Sana for medium and large enterprise customers, from discovery and design through go-live and post-launch optimisation.

Lead project and program delivery

Define and manage project scope, plan, timelines, risks, and dependencies across multiple work streams.
Ensure delivery within the budget and scope outlined in the Statement of Work, proactively managing changes and trade-offs.
Coordinate internal Sana resources and external partners to deliver against project objectives.

Engage senior customer stakeholders

Build and maintain trusted advisor relationships with executive sponsors and key decision makers.
Facilitate steering committees and executive readouts, clearly articulating progress, risks, and business impact.
Align Sana’s roadmap and capabilities with the customer’s strategic priorities and success metrics.

Drive adoption and measurable impact

Define, track, and report on success metrics and KPIs for each engagement.
Work closely with customer project managers and business owners to promote adoption, ensure change readiness, and drive continuous improvement.
Identify optimisation and expansion opportunities that increase the value customers realise from Sana.

Provide strategic and solution guidance

Translate business requirements into solution designs and implementation plans in collaboration with Solution Engineering and Product.
Advise customers on best practices for learning, change management, and digital adoption, leveraging Sana’s capabilities.
Challenge and refine customer requirements where needed to ensure viable, scalable, and high-impact solutions.

Collaborate cross-functionally and with partners

Work effectively with Sales to scope new engagements, shape proposals, and ensure a smooth transition from pre‑sales to delivery.
Manage third-party partners or vendors as part of the overall project team, maintaining accountability for overall outcomes.
Provide structured feedback to Product and Engineering based on customer needs and deployment learnings.

Basic Qualifications (P3 Engagement Manager)

At least 5 years of progressively responsible experience in Enterprise software implementation, management consulting, or customer success / professional services roles.
Direct experience leading complex implementation projects in medium or large enterprises, with responsibility for scope, timeline, budget, stakeholder management, and outcomes

You will thrive in this role if you:

Are naturally curious, always seeking to learn, and view every challenge as a growth opportunity.
Have strong project and program management skills, with a solid track record leading complex implementations in a Professional Services or Customer Success environment.
Are comfortable engaging with C‑level and senior stakeholders, with excellent communication and presentation skills.
Possess grit and determination, allowing you to weather setbacks and persist towards ambitious goals.
Are driven by excellence and high standards in planning, execution, and stakeholder management.
Embody humbleness and a collaborative mindset, always ready to learn from others and co‑create solutions.
Are deeply committed to our mission of changing the way the world learns and have a genuine passion for driving customer impact.
Are strong at building relationships, working cross-functionally, and influencing internal and external stakeholders.

title: LabVIEW Developer - Automation
description:
Overview

Who we are—

Transcat is a dynamic, innovative, growing company that has been recognized as the leading calibration and compliance services provider in North America and beyond. With 1,500 employees—in technical, consulting, operational, sales, finance, and corporate roles—we have stood the test of time by delivering on our Trust in Every Measure promise to our customers in vital industries, including life sciences, aerospace, defense, energy, and utilities. We fulfill this promise through our employees, who live Our Values every day, the Transcat Way. Our employees are at the center of the rewarding, challenging, and life-changing work we do for our customers and those they serve. Are you ready to join a company where the work you do makes a difference, and where you can grow in your career?

Here’s what Transcat has to offer—

  • Work that matters
  • A values-based culture where people care about each other and the work they do together
  • Flexibility
  • Training and development to accelerate learning and career advancement
  • Competitive compensation and benefits, including paid time off, health insurance, tuition reimbursement, retirement, stock purchase plan, and MORE!

Position Summary

We are seeking a skilled LabVIEW Developer to design, build, and maintain automated calibration systems. In this role, you will collaborate to architect scalable LabVIEW applications, integrate National Instruments (NI) hardware, and automate data acquisition and analysis workflows.

Responsibilities

Software & System Development

  • System Architecture & Development: Design, develop, and debug modular, maintainable LabVIEW applications using established software design patterns and best practices to ensure scalability, reliability, and long-term maintainability.
  • Hardware Integration: Integrate NI hardware platforms, including PXI/PXIe, CompactRIO, and CompactDAQ, as well as third-party instrumentation using industry-standard communication interfaces such as GPIB, RS-232/485, USB, and Ethernet.
  • User Interface & Data Management: Develop intuitive user interfaces for real-time monitoring and data visualization, and implement data management solutions using TDMS, SQL, CSV, or other storage technologies to support high-throughput test and measurement applications.

Calibration Automation & Procedure Development

  • Automated Test Development: Develop automated test procedures using LabVIEW, or custom execution engines to verify test equipment performance and satisfy testing requirements, applying appropriate measurement techniques referencing the equipment operating manuals and recognized published calibration methods.
  • Procedure Alignment & Compliance: Collaborate with datasheet authors to ensure calibration datasheets align with automated verification methods, including accurate tolerances, measurement parameters, complete functional test coverage, and measurement uncertainty requirements where applicable.
  • Metrology Collaboration: Partner with the metrology team to develop and maintain procedures in accordance with established policies, standards, and guidance documents used for creating manual calibration methods.

Technical Support & Continuous Improvement

  • Technical Support & Troubleshooting: Provide technical support to diagnose and resolve procedure, software, and hardware issues, including root-cause analysis, corrective actions, and implementation of bug fixes.
  • Technical Documentation: Produce and maintain high-quality technical documentation, including procedures, block diagrams, system architecture, user manuals, and operational guides to support development, maintenance, and end-user activities.
  • Training & Knowledge Transfer: Develop tutorials, training materials, and user guidance to enable both new and experienced personnel to effectively utilize automated calibration and test processes.
  • Customer Communication: Clearly communicate calibration processes, technical concepts, and issue resolutions to customers and stakeholders as needed.

Qualifications

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Calibration & Metrology

  • Calibration & Metrology Experience: Experience in PMEL (Precision Measurement Equipment Laboratory), TMDE (Test, Measurement, and Diagnostic Equipment) calibration laboratories, or equivalent environments is highly desired.
  • Technical Subject Matter Expertise: Recognized expertise in one or more calibration disciplines is strongly preferred.
  • Measurement Uncertainty Analysis: Understanding of measurement uncertainty principles within automated calibration processes, including the evaluation of uncertainty contributions and the impact of standard substitutions.
  • Instrumentation Knowledge: Strong familiarity with complex instrumentation, laboratory tools, and electronic test and measurement equipment.
  • Adaptability to Emerging Technologies: Ability to quickly learn, evaluate, and apply new test equipment technologies, methodologies, and measurement concepts.
  • Calibration Automation: Proficiency with Fluke MET/CAL Calibration Management Software and the ability to translate manual calibration procedures into efficient, automated test processes.

Software Development & Automation

  • LabVIEW Development Experience: Minimum of 3 years of professional experience designing and developing modular, maintainable software systems using LabVIEW.
  • Software Development Expertise: Experience developing software in multiple programming languages, with the ability to evaluate requirements and select the most effective development platform, language, or framework for a given application.
  • NI Hardware Integration: Hands-on experience integrating and supporting National Instruments hardware platforms, including cDAQ, cRIO, and PXI systems, along with sensor signal conditioning technologies.
  • Communication Protocols: Solid understanding of industry-standard communication protocols and instrument control methods, including Serial (RS-232/485), TCP/IP, SCPI, USB, and Ethernet-based communications.

Professional Skills

  • Project & Time Management: Exceptional organizational, prioritization, and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines effectively.

Preferred Qualifications

Certifications

  • Professional Certifications: ASQ Certified Calibration Technician (CCT) certification and/or a strong background in statistics is a plus.
  • LabVIEW Certification: Certified LabVIEW Developer (CLD) or Certified LabVIEW Architect (CLA) certification preferred.

Advanced Technical Experience

  • Advanced NI Software Experience: Experience with National Instruments software platforms and modules.
  • Calibration & Quality Standards Knowledge: Background in calibration, test, or metrology environments with working knowledge of ISO/IEC 17025 requirements and quality system principles.
  • Software Integration Experience: Experience integrating LabVIEW applications with external software libraries and technologies, including DLLs, C/C++, Python, and C#.
  • Automated Test & Measurement Systems: Experience developing, deploying, and supporting automated test, measurement, or calibration systems in laboratory or production environments.
  • System Architecture & Performance Optimization: Familiarity with software architecture, code optimization, and performance tuning for complex test and automation applications.

Education and Experience

A diploma from a technical, military or trade school and/or an associate’s or higher degree in engineering, electronics, or related technical field with 5+ years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is regularly required to stand; walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee is occasionally required to sit and talk or hear. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision and ability to adjust focus.

Work Environment

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

Equal Opportunity and Non-Discrimination

Transcat is an equal-opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination based on any protected status. As required by United States law, all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, disability, genetic predisposition or carrier status, national origin, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), status as a protected veteran, or as a member of any other protected group or activity under federal, state, and local law.

We will make reasonable accommodations for employees with disabilities to enable them to perform the essential functions of their position unless doing so poses an undue hardship to the company or a direct threat to health or safety.

Contingencies

All offers of employment are contingent upon successfully completing all pre-employment requirements, which include verification of identity and employment eligibility, and when applicable, a motor vehicle driving record report.

title: Ondersteunend medewerker, Laag Dalemseweg 70-2 Gorinchem
description:
Wij zijn voor Laagdalemseweg 70-2 in Gorinchem op zoek naar een ondersteunend medewerker.

Je werkzaamheden
Elke ochtend om 07.00 uur start jouw werkdag op deze mooie locatie in de nieuwbouwwijk van Gorinchem. Hier wonen 9 bewoners met een licht of matige verstandelijke beperking tussen de 50 en 85 jaar. Alle cliënten zijn mobiel en kunnen verbaal communiceren. Jij zorgt samen met jou collega voor structuur, maar ook voor gezelligheid in ochtend. Jij voelt aan wat iemand nodig heeft, met de een maak je een grapje, de ander ondersteun je in alle rust. Je praat niet alleen, je luistert en ziet. Je bent oprecht geïnteresseerd in hoe het met iemand gaat, en dat merken ze. Naast de ondersteuning bij het ontbijt moment help jij ook bij de zorg zoals douchen, scheren en aankleden. Waar mogelijk doe je zoveel mogelijk samen met de bewoners, jij weet hen te betrekken binnen eigen mogelijkheden. Humor gebruik je net zo makkelijk als een schoonmaakmiddel!

Na de drukte van de ochtend verschuift de aandacht naar jouw grootste taak: het schoonmaken van de woning. Jij zorgt ervoor dat de woning schoon, fris en in orde blijft. Dat de badkamer blinkt, de vloer gedweild is, de was schoon en gevouwen op de juiste kamer ligt. Je hebt oog voor wat nodig is: even snel iets bijbestellen, een bezoeker ontvangen, meelopen met een bewoner naar een afspraak. Je houdt van aanpakken. Van dingen zien en meteen doen. Je werkt gedeeltelijk zelfstandig, maar staat nooit los van het team. Jij bent die stabiele kracht in de ochtend, iemand op wie we kunnen bouwen en op wie de bewoners elke dag opnieuw kunnen rekenen.

Jij herkent jezelf hierin
Je houdt van een afwisselende werkdag en vindt het leuk om ondersteunend werk te doen.

  • Je hebt ervaring in huishoudelijk werk en vindt dit leuk om te doen.

  • Je bent de woensdag, Donderdag en vrijdag beschikbaar

  • Je maakt makkelijk contact met bewoners en collega’s en beheerst de Nederlandse taal goed.

Are you ready to shape the future of healthcare?

Evinova, a healthtech leader, is seeking a passionate and experienced Senior Data Engineer to build and automate our data foundation to enable our products, data science, and agents to deliver category leading capabilities. Join us in leveraging cutting-edge technology, data, and AI to revolutionize life sciences and improve billions of lives globally.

Key Responsibilities

  • AWS Data Services: Strong hands-on experience with Lake Formation, Glue (ETL + Catalogue + Schema Registry), Athena, and at least one of EMR / Redshift Serverless. You understand how these compose, not just how each works in isolation.
  • Open Table Formats: Production experience with S3 Tables, Apache Iceberg (preferred), or Delta Lake. You understand partition evolution, schema evolution, time travel, and compaction — and when each matter.
  • Streaming: Built production streaming pipelines with Kinesis Data Streams or MSK. Comfortable with exactly once semantics, windowing, late-arriving data, and backpressure.
  • Infrastructure as Code: AWS CDK (TypeScript) or CloudFormation. You define infrastructure in code, not in the console. CI/CD for data pipelines is expected, we currently use GitHub Actions, and some Terraform.
  • Data Modelling: Can design dimensional models, event schemas, and slowly changing dimensions. Understand the trade-offs between normalized and denormalized storage for different access patterns.
  • Governance and Security: Practical experience implementing column-level security, row-level filtering, or tag-based access control. Understands how data classification drives policy.
  • Python or Spark: For ETL logic, feature extraction, and data quality validation. PySpark or Spark Scala for distributed transforms.
  • AI & Machine Learning: Exposure to AI tools and frameworks is a plus.
  • Mentorship: Mentor and guide junior engineers and even your peers, fostering a culture of learning and collaboration. Help in adoption of the tooling, patterns, and automation best practices.
  • Collaboration: Partner with cross-functional teams, including product management and security, to align data foundation strategies with business goals and ensure cohesive development and operational workflows.

Required Experience & Qualifications

  • Experience: 7+ years in hands on data engineering, with strong experience in SaaS and multi-tenant data platforms. Proven track record of mentoring and helping other team members in data platform related projects.
  • Cloud Expertise: Strong understanding of AWS services, including VPC, IAM, EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, EKS, AWS WAF, and AWS CloudTrail.
  • Data Products: Strong knowledge of S3, RDS, DynamoDB, Kinesis, Glue, DataZone, Athena, RedShift Serverless, and AWS EventBridge.
  • Containerization & Orchestration: Strong proficiency in Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, and associated ecosystem tools.
  • CI/CD Proficiency: Expertise in CI/CD tools such as ArgoCD and GitHub Actions.
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Advanced experience with AWS CDK (TypeScript preferred) and CloudFormation.
  • Security: Good knowledge of IAM, AWS KMS, encryption standards, AWS WAF, and security compliance frameworks including NIST.
  • Monitoring & Alerting: Good experience with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, AWS CloudWatch, and AWS CloudTrail for monitoring and incident response.
  • Data & ETL Pipelines: Extensive knowledge with AWS Glue, AWS Kinesis, and Managed Kafka for real-time and batch data processing.
  • Programming & Automation: Strong scripting and automation skills using TypeScript and Bash.
  • Multi-Account AWS Management: Experience managing multiple AWS accounts with AWS Control Tower.
  • Communication & Collaboration: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse stakeholders.

Desired Experience & Qualifications

  • Advanced expertise in AWS CDK, including building complex, reusable constructs and pipelines.
  • Experience with monitoring and logging tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and AWS CloudWatch.
  • Exposure to multi-tenant SaaS platforms and best practices.
  • Experience working with AI tools and frameworks.

Personal Attributes

  • Mentor & Leader: Enjoys mentoring team members, and fostering a collaborative, innovation-driven team culture.
  • Organized & Adaptable: Able to manage multiple priorities and thrive in a fast-paced environment.
  • Innovative: Passionate about leveraging technology to solve complex problems and drive efficiency.

title: Data Engineering Lead - Ai-First, Scalable Pipelines
description:
About the company

Biorce is a pioneering Healthtech company dedicated to revolutionizing drug development through the power of AI. We are passionate about accelerating medical advancements and improving patient outcomes.

Our team comprises seasoned clinical research professionals, data scientists, and AI experts, working collaboratively to bridge the gap between cutting-edge technology and real-world clinical needs.

With an unwavering commitment to revolutionize healthcare, we envision a world where all patients benefit from accelerated and cost-effective access to treatments. Biorce is poised to redefine the landscape of healthcare, shaping a future where innovation and accessibility converge for the betterment of humanity.

About the role

We are seeking a Data Engineering Lead to head our data engineering team and serve as the department lead for our Barcelona hub. This is a senior, technical leadership role, a player-coach who is credible in architecture and code, but whose primary job is to build, grow, and multiply a high-performing team.

Biorce runs data engineering across two hubs, Barcelona and Austin keeping those teams working as one is central to this role. You will be the face of data engineering in Spain: the person who represents the function locally, builds our presence and employer brand in the Barcelona market, and partners closely with the Austin team to keep architecture, standards, and roadmap in sync across sites and time zones.

You will own the people, delivery, and health of the data engineering function at the Barcelona site: hiring and developing engineers (including senior ICs / Data Architect), driving execution against the platform roadmap, and setting the standards and culture, including how we responsibly adopt AI-first, agentic ways of working. You will be the connective tissue between the engineers building the platform and the data science, AI, MLOps, product, and clinical stakeholders who depend on it.

This is a rare chance to stand up and lead a team building a next-generation clinical data platform from the ground up, at the heart of our growing European presence.

Who We're Looking For

An experienced engineering leader who has led data or platform teams and still speaks the language fluently, someone engineers respect technically and want to work for. You care about people first, but you never lose sight of delivery, quality, and the realities of regulated clinical data. You are energized (not threatened) by an AI-first shift, and you know how to bring a team along through change.

You are equally comfortable running a 1:1, unblocking the mapping of a stubborn dataset into the common data model, defending a roadmap to leadership, and coaching an engineer on how (and when not) to trust a coding agent.

Key Responsibilities People Leadership
  • Lead, coach, and grow the Barcelona data engineering team including senior ICs and the Data Architect, through regular 1:1s, feedback, and career development.
  • Work with the Head of Data to design hiring for the team: define roles, run a high-quality and fair interview process, and build a strong, diverse pipeline.
  • Set clear expectations and run a fair, transparent performance and growth process;

    retain and develop top talent.
  • Foster a healthy, inclusive, high-trust team culture as the on-site department lead.
Delivery & Execution
  • Own delivery of the data engineering roadmap. Planning, prioritization, and predictable execution against platform milestones.
  • Establish lightweight, effective engineering processes (agile/iterative delivery, code review, on-call/incident response, documentation standards).
  • Track and communicate progress, risks, and trade-offs to Data / AI leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Balance speed of iteration with the reliability and compliance demands of clinical data.
Technical Direction (Player-Coach)
  • Partner with the Data Architect to set and uphold technical standards for the hybrid open-source + Databricks + dbt on GCP platform.
  • Provide credible technical guidance in design and architecture reviews;

    stay close enoughto the work to make good calls and unblock the team.
  • Champion quality: data reliability, lineage, observability, testing, and cost-efficiency (FinOps).
AI-First Culture & Adoption
  • Drive responsible adoption of AI-first, agentic data engineering across the team, Claude Code, coding agents, and the self-healing/agentic warehouse vision.
  • Establish team norms, guardrails, and review practices so AI-assisted work is fast and validated to clinical/regulated standards.
  • Measure and improve how AI leverage translates into team velocity and quality.
Cross-Hub Collaboration & Local Leadership
  • Keep the Barcelona and Austin data engineering teams working as one, aligned on architecture, standards, roadmap, and priorities, with clear ownership and smooth handoffs across time zones.
  • Partner with Austin leadership to plan work coherently across sites, avoid divergence or duplication, and share learnings both ways.
  • Be the face of data engineering in Spain, representing the function to local leadership, candidates, and partners, and building Biorce's presence and employer brand in the Barcelona market.
Stakeholder & Department Leadership
  • Represent data engineering across data science, AI, MLOps, product, and clinical/regulatory teams.
  • Ensure the team's work supports compliance with SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, and clinical data governance.
  • Contribute to headcount planning, budgeting, and vendor/tooling decisions for the function.
Must-Haves
  • 8+ years in data engineering / software engineering, including 3+ years leading data or platform engineering teams.
  • Track record of hiring, growing, and retaining strong engineers, and running fair performance processes.
  • Proven delivery leadership, planning and shipping complex data/platform work predictably.
  • Strong technical credibility: hands-on background in data engineering with the ability to reason about Databricks/Spark, dbt, SQL/Python, and cloud (GCP) architecture, even if you no longer code daily.
  • Experience leading teams through change or new ways of working (new platform, tooling, or process) with real adoption.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder skills across technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience working across distributed, multi-site teams and time zones, keeping them aligned and collaborative.
  • Comfort acting as a visible local leader, representing a function externally and internally in-region.
  • Genuine enthusiasm for AI-first / agentic engineering and a thoughtful view on adopting it responsibly.
  • Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
Nice-to-Haves
  • Experience standing up or leading a greenfield data platform or a new team/site.
  • Experience in clinical, biomedical, or healthcare data and regulated environments (HIPAA, GDPR), including common data models (OMOP CDM, FHIR).
  • Familiarity with AI coding assistants/agents (e.G., Claude Code) in an engineering org.
  • Exposure to MLOps / data science partnership and productionizing ML data flows.
  • Experience with FinOps / cloud cost management at scale.
  • Prior experience as a hands-on data engineer or architect earlier in your career.
  • Working proficiency in English;

    Spanish is a plus.
Why Join Us?
  • Build and lead the team behind a next-generation clinical data platform and define what an AI-first data engineering function looks like in a regulated environment.
  • A dynamic work environment with an international team, where collaboration and diversity thrive.
  • Work alongside top talent, united by a shared purpose and committed to making a real impact.

title: Delivery Lead
description:
Delivery Lead – AI & Client Discovery (Lead Consultant)

London - Hybrid

£90 - £115k


The Delivery Lead is a fully customer-facing role which comes with ownership of client engagements - and, in the new world, ownership of the discovery that shapes them. As Enablis shifts its mix from today's largely traditional delivery to an even split with AI-native work over the next year, the Delivery Lead works across both: leading conventional delivery engagements to the standard clients already trust us for, and leading the new value-led arcs - an assessment measured in days or weeks, a POC build of around six weeks, an MVP with a mandate - that end on evidence, not a calendar.


In new-world engagements this role absorbs what a discovery-led product person would do elsewhere: interrogating problems, asking why, and shaping what should be built before anything is committed. The Delivery Lead owns the question every engagement must answer - “so what?” - and makes sure no build starts without a clear view of who will use it, what it is worth, and what happens at scale.

They shape work rather than take orders, pushing back where needed. On larger engagements they pair with a Commercial Business Analyst who owns the value model in depth.


A crucial part of the remit remains managing stakeholder relationships and expectations across a wide variety of customer and third-party roles and levels of seniority - empathetic and relatable to the inexperienced, whilst capable of operating opposite the most senior people in complex commercial environments. The Delivery Lead also acts as a bridge back to our central teams: contributing to governance, sharing reusable assets and proof points with BD, and feeding our communities of practice.


Key Skills

Discovery and value (new world)

  • Running discovery workshops and structured interviews that produce a one-page problem statement, a named sponsor and a shortlisted use case
  • Workflow immersion and knowledge capture: sitting with the people who do the work, mapping who does the task today, which systems it touches, whether the data is good enough, where a person must stay in control, and what the work costs now
  • Rapidly screening and prioritising candidate workflows on value and ease - building the ranked backlog that feeds a client roadmap
  • Building a defensible value case before and during the build - value the client's CFO can sign off, not cycle-time anecdotes - and turning the assessment into the scope, protecting fixed-price commercials from drift
  • Testing agent-user fit: can the AI do the work, will users trust it enough to delegate, and does it pay


Evidence-led delivery (new world)

  • Prototype-led ways of working: always showing something tangible - discovery without prototypes doesn't fly anymore
  • Running evidence-based gates: go / adjust / stop - and treating an honest “stop” as a good outcome
  • Planning beyond the POC: the route to production, who would own and run the solution, and the mini operating model that lets it scale
  • Measuring value, not activity - including adoption measured against a baseline


AI fluency

  • Uses AI daily and can demo a working prototype with confidence
  • Understands what makes AI delivery different: probabilistic outputs, evaluation and guardrails, and the trust users must build before they delegate to a system


Delivery ways of working (both worlds)

  • Strong working knowledge and the ability to embody agile principles, with experience of mainstream methods (Scrum, Kanban, Lean/Startup) and standard ceremonies
  • Able to fit into, or work alongside, traditional project and programme management structures - many client engagements still run this way, and will for some time
  • A clear and concise approach to documentation


People and stakeholders (both worlds)

  • First-class people skills and emotional intelligence; the ability to cultivate strong stakeholder relationships
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, from front-line teams to C-suite
  • Commercial and political awareness, and an instinct for both risk and opportunity - spotting and scoping the next opportunity from a problem lens is part of delivery quality
  • Willing to embrace complexity and uncertainty; the energy to motivate and inspire a team during difficult periods
  • A creative streak which adds an element of joy for our people and customers

The company provides all its services in over 80 countries worldwide and generates 74% of its turnover internationally. Context

The QA/QC Manager is responsible for establishing, implementing, and maintaining the Quality Assurance and Quality Control system for the Alexandria Tram Project. The role ensures that all project activities, deliverables, materials, workmanship, and documentation comply with SYSTRA Egypt standards, client requirements, contract specifications, applicable codes, and relevant regulatory requirements. Missions/Main Duties

  • Establish project QA/QC procedures, quality objectives, inspection and test plans, and control processes.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable standards, technical specifications, approved drawings, method statements, and quality requirements.
  • Monitor project activities to verify that construction, installation, testing, and commissioning works meet defined quality standards.
  • Review and approve quality documentation submitted by contractors and subcontractors, including inspection requests, method statements, material submittals, and test reports.
  • Coordinate inspections and witness points with project teams, contractors, consultants, and client representatives.
  • Manage non-conformance reports, site observations, corrective actions, and preventive actions to ensure timely resolution and closure.
  • Conduct internal quality audits and participate in external audits by clients, certification bodies, or authorities as required.
  • Monitor laboratory testing, field testing, material approvals, and workmanship inspections to ensure compliance with project requirements.
  • Ensure that all quality records, test certificates, inspection reports, and handover dossiers are properly maintained and controlled.
  • Support supplier and subcontractor quality evaluations and performance monitoring.
  • Track quality KPIs and prepare periodic quality reports for project management and the client.
  • Promote continuous improvement and lessons learned across the project.
  • Support project teams during testing, commissioning, snagging, and final acceptance activities.

Profile/Skills

  • Minimum 10 years of relevant QA/QC experience.
  • Minimum 5 years in a QA/QC managerial or senior quality role.
  • Proven experience on large construction, rail, tram, metro, or infrastructure projects.
  • Experience with quality management systems, audits, inspections, and testing processes.
  • Experience in contractor and subcontractor quality oversight.
  • Good knowledge of international standards, contract specifications, and project documentation requirements.

title: Software Development Lead
description:

Working closely with the Director of Development, the Director of Engineering and Architecture, Product Owner, Delivery Manager, quality engineers, and other stakeholders, you will shape achievable delivery plans, guide technical decisions, manage engineering risks, and ensure that solutions meet agreed organisational standards. Through the Director of Engineering and Architecture, you will have access to the Architecture and Platform teams, who will provide specialist support for architecture, DevOps, cloud, and infrastructure decisions and delivery.


You will lead and mentor engineers primarily across the Back End Microsoft .NET ecosystem. This role is suitable for either a Back End specialist or a Full Stack engineer with strong back-end expertise and practical experience across the React and TypeScript front end. You will have sufficient working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, GitHub Actions, Azure Pipelines, Microsoft Azure, and infrastructure as code using Terraform to contribute effectively, identify when specialist input is required, and work with the Architecture and Platform teams through design, delivery, and operational processes.

  • Design, build, test, and maintain secure, observable, reliable, and maintainable production software, leading by example in the squad’s most complex or high-risk areas.
  • Lead, coach, and mentor engineers through pairing, design discussions, code reviews, technical feedback, and clear development expectations.
  • Collaborate with the Director of Development, Product Owner, and Delivery Manager to shape achievable delivery plans, provide technical estimates, identify dependencies, and balance scope, quality, risk, and delivery commitments.
  • Work with the Architecture team to provide appropriate technical direction for the squad across solution design, security, integration, testing, observability, performance, deployment, and operational readiness, escalating decisions that require specialist architectural input.
  • Partner with product managers, business analysts, quality engineers, platform engineers, and other stakeholders to clarify requirements, identify technical constraints, and translate business priorities into sustainable engineering outcomes.
  • Establish and maintain engineering standards covering source control, branching, pull requests, coding practices, automated testing, secure development, documentation, and release readiness.
  • Own effective technical assurance within the squad through code review, automated quality controls, security scanning, testing, pairing, and technical walkthroughs.
  • Work with the Platform team to support the implementation and continuous improvement of CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and Azure Pipelines, contributing application and delivery knowledge while relying on platform specialists for shared tooling, controls, and infrastructure.
  • Collaborate with the Platform and Architecture teams to ensure deployments use appropriate environment controls, approvals, quality gates, secrets management, rollback approaches, and operational verification.
  • Contribute application and domain knowledge to the design, deployment, and operation of cloud-native solutions on Microsoft Azure, working with the Architecture and Platform teams to address security, resilience, scalability, observability, performance, and cost.
  • Work with the Platform team when infrastructure as code is required, contributing to the review and application of Terraform changes without being expected to own shared modules, state management, or the organisation-wide infrastructure process.
  • Communicate technical progress, trade-offs, risks, and decisions clearly to both engineering and non-technical stakeholders, escalating material concerns early and presenting practical options.
  • Identify and manage technical and delivery risks, including security, dependency, performance, reliability, operational, and technical-debt concerns.
  • Support software in production through monitoring, incident response, root-cause analysis, service improvement, and the responsible management of technical debt.
  • Evaluate relevant technologies and engineering practices against genuine product and operational needs, leading improvements that reduce risk, improve developer effectiveness, strengthen reliability, or create measurable customer value.
  • Help the squad improve delivery flow, predictability, quality, and operational performance using meaningful engineering and delivery measures.

Leadership and Core Engineering

  • Experience working in iterative product-delivery environments and adapting engineering practices to improve flow, feedback, quality, and predictability.

Back End Engineering (Required)

  • Understanding of microservices, event-driven architecture, messaging, asynchronous processing, and appropriate service-boundary design.
  • Experience with relational data, SQL Server, Entity Framework Core, transaction management, data modelling, and integration patterns.

DevOps, Cloud, and Infrastructure Knowledge

title: Private Lacrosse Coach
description:
Coach lacrosse on your own schedule in Lexington, Kentucky.

STXZ Lacrosse has 1 opening(s) for independent lacrosse coaches in the Lexington area, to cover client requests for private lessons we can't currently fill. We bring you the clients. You run the sessions.

About STXZ

STXZ is a technology platform that connects families with independent lacrosse coaches across the United States. We send you clients in your area, handle the administrative work, and get out of your way so you can coach. If you have lacrosse experience and want coaching work on a flexible schedule, this is for you.

How it works

When a family near Lexington requests lessons through STXZ, we send you a client offer with the details. You review it and decide whether to take it. No quotas, no pressure, no penalty for declining.

When you accept:

  • You contact the client directly within 24 hours
  • You and the client agree on schedule and location: their home, a local field, a park, your call
  • You run the session your way. Drills, pacing, and structure are your professional judgment
  • You submit a quick lesson briefing on the platform after the session
  • You get paid

STXZ never tells you how to coach, what drills to use, or how to structure your lessons.

What you earn

  • $35 to $50 per one-hour session, paid as a flat per-lesson rate. Rates are set by STXZ, vary by market and demand, and are confirmed in writing before your first lesson.
  • Payout within 24 to 48 hours after you submit your lesson briefing, via PayPal
  • 1099-NEC issued at year end if you earn $2,000 or more through the platform
  • Paid per completed session. Lesson volume depends on client demand in your area, and STXZ does not guarantee a minimum number of lessons.
  • No fee to apply, and nothing to pay up front

Schedule

Most lessons run weekday afternoons and evenings and on weekends. Work when you want and pause your availability anytime.

What you control

  • Your schedule. Accept or decline every offer without penalty or impact on your standing.
  • Your methods. Drills, lesson plans, teaching style, all yours.
  • Your territory. Set your own travel radius, from a few miles to 35 or more.
  • Your approach. You decide what equipment to bring to each session.

What STXZ handles

  • Client acquisition. We market the platform and bring families to you.
  • Matching. We send you local client offers that fit your profile.
  • Payment processing. We collect from clients and pay you after each session.
  • Billing, refunds, and disputes. Our support team handles all of it. You coach.
  • Liability coverage. Active coaches are enrolled in STXZ's platform liability coverage program for sessions booked through STXZ. The program fee is $30 per year, and it is $0 down: nothing is due to get started or to begin receiving client offers. The fee is recovered from your first lesson payout once you start coaching. This is limited coverage for platform-booked sessions only; independent coaches may also choose to carry their own personal insurance.

Who this is for

  • Coaching experience at the youth, high school, club, or college level, or playing experience at the high school varsity, club, college, or professional level
  • 18 or older
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States
  • Willing to complete a third-party background check, arranged by STXZ, before receiving full client details
  • Reliable transportation to training locations in your area
  • Your own stick and basic training equipment: cones, balls, training aids
  • Strong communication with parents, players, and the STXZ team
  • Professionalism and confidence working independently with families and youth athletes

How to apply

Apply here (about 2 minutes). If your background fits, we send a short coaching profile questionnaire: playing history, coaching experience, positions, availability. After review and background screening, approved coaches start receiving local client offers.

STXZ is a technology platform that connects clients with independent lacrosse coaches. STXZ does not employ, supervise, manage, or control coaches or their training sessions. Coaches are engaged as independent contractors and are responsible for their own coaching methods, taxes, and scheduling. STXZ considers all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

Enterprises and agencies use us to run live and on-demand events for their people and their customers. We have streamed more than 7,000 of them to date, on infrastructure built on AWS, Fastly and HIVE, and we are ISO 27001 certified.


About the role

We are looking for a software engineer to join our engineering team in Barcelona.


You will work across the whole product — one large monorepo with more than twenty deployable services and applications, actively developed and shipped. You will take features from idea to production: the interface, the services behind it, the data, and the tests. We do not split front-end from back-end between people.


You will also decide what gets built. Nobody hands you a specification or a mockup; you take a real need, work out what it should become, design it, and ship it. Your work reaches users in days.


You will do your best work here if you enjoy owning a problem end to end and want your decisions to matter.


Responsibilities

  • Scope, build and ship full-stack features — infrastructure, services, interfaces, data and tests.
  • Review your colleagues' code, and have yours reviewed.

Minimum qualifications

  • A degree in computer science, software engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong TypeScript and modern JavaScript
  • Node back-end experience — REST APIs, request lifecycle, authentication and authorisation.
  • Depth in a component-based front-end framework. Ours is Angular but we care how you reason about component design, state and reactivity, not which syntax you know.
  • Relational databases and an ORM.
  • Experience working in a large codebase you did not write.

Preferred qualifications

Hey there, Kubernetes people!

Every engineer here waits on CI several times a day. We want someone who finds that wait personally annoying.

Why this role exists?

Hundreds of developers push to a large Ruby on Rails monorepo, and every push lands on a runner fleet that the Developer Experience team builds, runs and keeps fast.

That fleet is self-hosted Kubernetes on bare metal in European datacentres, in the low hundreds of machines, running **ephemeral** GitHub Actions runners that peak above a thousand concurrent pods. We own all of it: the hardware, the clusters, the runner images, the caches and the delivery pipelines on top. We add nodes by hand rather than letting an autoscaler do it, so capacity planning is genuinely part of the job.

The leverage is unusual. Shave a minute off the average build and every engineer in the company gets that minute back, several times a day.

The mission

  • Own the CI and CD Kubernetes clusters end to end: capacity, reliability, upgrades, security and cost.
  • Run the self-hosted GitHub Actions platform at scale with Actions Runner Controller. Runner scale sets, **ephemeral** pods, docker-in-docker, and the runner images themselves.
  • Keep the data services our tests depend on fast and healthy. MySQL, Redis and ClickHouse come up per job, alongside Rails application containers.
  • Design and tune the caching that makes builds quick: node-local overlay, image and artifact caches we build ourselves, plus pull-through registry mirrors.
  • Bring queue wait and build duration down, with measurement behind it. Instrument the platform, set targets, and show the improvement.
  • Manage it all as code. Terraform planned and applied from pull requests, GitOps delivery with Flux and Argo CD, Kustomize and Helm for manifests.
  • Provision and operate bare metal. Linux, networking across datacentre segments, and troubleshooting that sometimes ends up at the disk or the kernel.
  • Lead incident response for the platform, run blameless postmortems, and turn each one into an alert, a guardrail or a runbook.
  • Treat the platform as a product whose users are engineers. Talk to them, watch where they get stuck, and build paths that make the right thing easy.

Your day to day

  • Rightsizing runner tiers against a week of CPU and memory data, then opening the pull request that changes them.
  • Tracking a flaky job from a red check down to the container runtime, the kernel, or a clock that drifted.
  • Adding machines to the fleet: install, enrol, network, verify, document.
  • Cutting p95 queue wait by working out which stage actually blocks.
  • Upgrading a cluster or a controller without anyone noticing.
  • Pairing with a product engineer on a workflow that has been slow for a reason nobody has looked at yet.

Your profile

  • 5+ years running production infrastructure, with Kubernetes at the centre of it.
  • Real depth in Kubernetes: scheduling, requests and limits, evictions, node pressure, DaemonSets, controllers and operators. You have debugged a cluster that was lying to you.
  • Strong Linux and container fundamentals. containerd or Docker internals, cgroups, namespaces, storage drivers, networking.
  • Terraform and infrastructure as code, with a feel for module design and state hygiene.
  • CI/CD at the platform level: shared workflows, reusable templates, runner architecture, build caching.
  • Comfortable with GitHub Actions, including self-hosted runners.
  • You script to automate. Bash, plus at least one of Python or Go.
  • Observability as a working method. Metrics, logs, traces, dashboards and alerts that people trust, with OpenTelemetry and Prometheus style tooling.
  • Operational maturity. On-call, incident command, postmortems, and the discipline to chase causes.
  • Capacity and cost awareness. You can size a fleet and explain the bill.
  • Clear written English. You document what you build, because the next person on call will not be you.

Bonus points

  • Large Ruby on Rails test suites, and what it takes to parallelise them honestly.
  • Operating MySQL, Redis or ClickHouse yourself.
  • Bare metal: provisioning, hardware failure, and the different rhythm it has compared to cloud.
  • Overlay and WireGuard style mesh networking, VLANs, and Kubernetes CNIs such as Cilium.
  • Building internal developer tooling, portals or platform APIs.
  • Supply chain and build security. Runner isolation, secret scoping, image provenance.
  • Working across more than one cloud. We use AWS, Azure and Cloudflare alongside our own hardware.
  • Contributions to open source infrastructure projects.

How we work

At Factorial, we believe the best products are built when people come together, in person, to collaborate, challenge ideas, and move fast. That's why our Engineering Team follows an office-first, flexible approach.

We work on-site several days a week (80%), using that time to connect, align, and innovate as a team. However, we also support remote work when it makes sense (20%) for deep focus or personal needs.

At Factorial we don't evaluate you by years of experience but by your knowledge and skills.

We use our Career Path with a rubric framework where we define what is expected for each experience level and skill. This framework allows you to know your current level and what you need to keep growing. We love transparency, so our Career Path includes the salaries for each level, which we share during the first interview to ensure alignment.

Our Hiring Process

  • Intro Call → Chat with our Talent Partner about your journey and goals.
  • Hiring Manager Interview → Deep dive into your product mindset, teamwork, and problem-solving.
  • Technical Interview → A collaborative technical conversation with the team based on real-life problems.
  • Final Coffee Chat → A relaxed conversation with our CTO & VP of Engineering to explore our vision, culture, and your growth.

And that's it! Feel free to request any other conversations you want, with team members or to address specific concerns at any time in the process. The whole process is remote, using videoconferencing tools!

About Factorial

At Factorial, we're building the leading AI Business Management Software for companies of all sizes. Our platform centralizes key workflows across HR, Finance, Talent, Operations, and IT, freeing teams from manual processes so they can focus on what really matters: leading, growing, and taking care of their people. With over 1,500 employees across Europe, Asia, Africa, and America. We are one of Europe's fastest-growing SaaS companies, proudly headquartered in Barcelona. About Xe

Xe is a cross-border payments platform. We help SMEs and consumers in the US, UK, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand collect, convert, hold, and send money across markets. Each year, over 300 million people use Xe for currency information and over 350,000 use us to send money overseas.


Today, we're rebuilding the platform layer behind cross-border payments for corporate and consumer clients. We're small enough that your code ships fast and your decisions matter, and Euronet Worldwide (Nasdaq: EEFT) backs us so the problems stay real-scale.


About This Role

We're hiring a senior full-stack engineer who owns real problems end-to-end and shapes how the team builds, from API design and frontend experience through to backend services, production reliability, and launch. You already use AI as part of how you think, build, test, and ship.


You'll write code that moves money in production, design and modernize the platform across the stack, and lead delivery of customer-facing features as Xe rebuilds its platform layer. You'll work in a small engineering team with direct access to product, design, and compliance, own architecture in your domain, lead design reviews, mentor mid-level engineers, and partner with architects and team leads on cross-domain decisions.

  • Design and own features across the stack that move money and manage multi-currency balances across a range of domains, including onboarding, KYC and KYB, payment initiation, FX, settlement, and other supporting services.

  • Strong backend proficiency in C# / .NET preferred; other OOP languages welcome (Java, Kotlin, Go, or equivalent).

title: Embedded Software Engineer
description:
Als Embedded Software Engineer kom je terecht binnen een hoogtechnologisch productiebedrijf dat wereldwijd meetapparatuur ontwikkelt voor de metaalindustrie. Binnen deze rol ligt de focus op het ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en optimaliseren van embedded software voor geavanceerde temperatuurmeetsystemen die functioneren in extreme productieomgevingen.
De functie combineert softwareontwikkeling, elektronica en systeemintegratie in een technisch uitdagende context waar betrouwbaarheid en precisie centraal staan. Je werkt nauw samen met ervaren engineers aan innovatieve oplossingen die internationaal worden ingezet binnen industriële productieprocessen.



Wat ga je doen?



Embedded softwareontwikkeling

Je ontwikkelt en onderhoudt embedded software in C en C++ voor ARM-gebaseerde controllers. Daarbij vertaal je functionele vereisten naar betrouwbare en performante softwareoplossingen. Je schrijft software die metingen en signalen verwerkt, interpreteert en communiceert met hardware en drivers. Ook denk je actief mee over softwaredesign, requirements en systeemarchitectuur en volg je nieuwe features op via het interne ticketsysteem.



Systeemintegratie en technische samenwerking

Je staat mee in voor de integratie en het testen van communicatieprotocollen zoals SPI, Ethernet, USB en BLE. Bij problemen analyseer en debug je embedded systemen en werk je gericht aan oplossingen. Daarnaast stem je nauw af met hardware- en elektronica-engineers en externe partners. Vanuit die samenwerking kijk je verder dan de software alleen en draag je bij aan de werking, kwaliteit en continue verbetering van het volledige systeem.





Wie ben jij?

  • Je beschikt over een Masterdiploma in elektronica, computerwetenschappen of een gelijkaardige technische richting.
  • Je brengt meerdere jaren relevante ervaring mee binnen Embedded Software Development en beschikt over een zeer goede kennis van C en C++.
  • Ervaring met ARM-controllers en Embedded systemen is noodzakelijk.
  • Je begrijpt hoe software samenwerkt met hardware, sensoren, signalen en drivers en kunt requirements zelfstandig interpreteren en vertalen naar concrete technische oplossingen.
  • Je neemt ownership over je werk, werkt proactief en formuleert zelfstandig technische keuzes en voorstellen.
  • Je communiceert open over ideeën, problemen en timing en werkt graag samen met collega's.
  • Je kijkt naar het volledige technische plaatje en combineert nauwkeurigheid met de nodige snelheid om vooruitgang te boeken.
  • Affiniteit met elektronica en hardware-integratie is een sterke troef.
  • Ervaring met Git en Azure DevOps is mooi meegenomen.
  • Kennis van Assembler of C# is een pluspunt, maar geen vereiste.

Voor deze functie is vooral belangrijk dat je als Ervaren engineer snel zelfstandig inzetbaar bent en voldoende technische bagage meebrengt om verantwoordelijkheid op te nemen.

title: Lead/Principle Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer
Clearance Required: Active SC Clearance (Mandatory)

The Opportunity

We're looking for a talented Data Engineer to join a growing team delivering secure, large-scale data solutions for government and public sector customers.

This is an exciting opportunity to work on complex data platforms that support critical decision-making and operational outcomes. You'll play a key role in building and enhancing secure batch and real-time data processing capabilities, working with modern cloud technologies and industry-leading open-source tools.

As part of a collaborative Agile team, you'll help design, develop, and optimise data pipelines, ensuring data is accurately processed, transformed, and delivered to downstream consumers. This role offers exposure to cutting-edge cloud and data technologies alongside the opportunity to work on meaningful projects within highly secure environments.

Please note: Active SC Clearance is an essential requirement for this position. Due to the nature of the work, candidates must already hold current and active SC Clearance. Unfortunately, sponsorship or clearance applications cannot be supported for this role.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, test, and maintain robust data pipelines that meet both functional and non-functional business requirements.
  • Design, build, and optimise data processing solutions to support batch and real-time analytics capabilities.
  • Contribute to logical and physical database design activities across a range of data platforms.
  • Expand and enhance platform capabilities, enabling the business to solve new and evolving data challenges.
  • Analyse complex datasets and identify opportunities to improve data processing, quality, and performance.
  • Ensure data models align with established data architecture standards, maintaining consistency across entities, relationships, and definitions.
  • Perform root cause analysis on data-related issues, identifying and implementing effective solutions.
  • Collaborate with engineers, architects, and stakeholders to deliver scalable and reliable data solutions.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives, helping to drive best practices across data engineering and platform development.
  • Produce clear technical documentation covering data pipelines, processes, and system enhancements.

Skills & Experience

Essential

  • Experience developing and maintaining data pipelines using modern data processing technologies and frameworks.
  • Knowledge of Agile delivery methodologies and experience working within fast-paced development environments.
  • Strong understanding of data modelling, data structures, and their advantages and limitations across different use cases.
  • Experience working with public cloud platforms, particularly AWS, including services such as EC2, RDS, Lambda, Athena, and Glue.
  • Experience configuring and optimising Relational and NoSQL databases, including query tuning and performance optimisation.
  • Proficiency in programming and scripting languages such as Python.
  • Experience applying Test-Driven Development (TDD) methodologies and associated testing frameworks.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work through complex data challenges.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary teams.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent commercial experience in a relevant discipline.

Desirable

  • Experience with CI/CD tooling such as Jenkins or Drone.
  • Knowledge of configuration management tools including Ansible and Packer.
  • Experience using Terraform for Infrastructure-as-Code deployments.
  • Understanding of both Linux and Windows environments.
  • Exposure to modern cloud-native architectures and DevOps practices.
  • Experience working within government, defence, or other highly regulated environments.

What You'll Bring

  • A passion for data engineering and solving complex technical problems.
  • A strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality solutions.
  • A collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively within Agile teams.
  • A proactive approach to learning new technologies and expanding your technical skillset.
  • The ability to translate business requirements into scalable and efficient data solutions.
  • A desire to contribute to projects that deliver meaningful impact within secure and mission-critical environments.

Security Clearance - Mandatory Requirement

Candidates must hold current and active SC (Security Check) Clearance at the time of application.

Applications from candidates who are eligible for clearance, willing to undergo clearance, or whose clearance has expired cannot be considered for this position.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a high-performing engineering team, working on innovative cloud and data platforms that support critical government programmes while developing your expertise with modern technologies and large-scale data solutions.

title: Junior Facilitair Coördinator
description:
Startdatum: in overleg

Uren: 32- 40 uur per week

Standplaats: Amsterdam (deels thuiswerken mogelijk)

Salaris: tussen de € 2.579 en € 3.899 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur)

Laten we bij het begin beginnen. Young Group is een facilitaire dienstverlener in onderzoeks- en onderwijsinstellingen, vastgoed en kantoren. Een combinatie die niet erg voor de hand ligt, we weten het, maar dat zorgt juist voor veel afwisseling in het werk. We werken en denken mee met verschillende opdrachtgevers op strategisch, tactisch en operationeel niveau over een breed scala aan onderwerpen. Dit varieert van de inzet van receptiedienstverlening tot het implementeren van duurzaamheid in de onderhoudsplannen. Ook onze klanten zijn divers. We werken samen met gemeentes en overheidsinstellingen, maar ook met kleine VvE’s en scholen.

Wat ga je doen als Junior Facilitair Coördinator bij Young Group?

In deze rol maak je kennis met verschillende facetten van de functie als facilitair coördinator. Zo ondersteun je de teamleiders in hun dagelijkse werkzaamheden. Dé ideale manier om het vak te leren kennen. Je helpt hen bij het maken en verbeteren van handboeken op locatie bij opdrachtgever. Ook evalueer en verbeter je diverse procedures binnen het werkveld en/of bij opdrachtgevers. Naast het ondersteunen ben je ook samen met jouw collega Junior facilitair coördinatoren verantwoordelijk voor het rondmaken van de planning en roostering van zowel het team van huismeesters als het team van receptiemedewerkers.

Verder zijn jij en je collega’s verantwoordelijk door de Servicedesk. Hierbij ben je eerste aanspreekpunt voor (potentiële) opdrachtgevers en medewerkers. Jij coördineert, handelt af en/of zorgt dat de juiste persoon benaderd wordt. Je verwerkt meldingen, storingen, verzoeken en klachten van klanten en collega’s via telefoon, e-mail en de online chat (whatsapp).

Uiteraard is dit een greep uit de werkzaamheden. Benieuwd wat je nog meer gaat doen? Neem dan contact met ons op of solliciteer!

Wie ben jij?

De minimale vereisten voor deze functie zijn dat je minimaal twee jaar werkervaring hebt in een vergelijkbare rol, in het bezit bent van een relevante MBO+/HBO diploma en kennis hebt van facilitair beheer en gebouwonderhoud. Ook beheers je de Nederlandse en Engelse taal goed in zowel woord als geschrift. Verder denk je graag mee over verbeteringen binnen de werkprocessen in de organisatie. Door de diversiteit in jouw functie werk je met verschillende onderdelen van ons FMIS systeem. Het is dan ook belangrijk dat je snel nieuwe systemen en werkprocessen oppakt. Ervaring met het maken van roosters/planningen is een enorme pré.

Waarom Young Group?

Simpel. Onze werksfeer en ons team. Oké, dat zegt iedere organisatie, maar bij ons is het écht zo. We zijn een hecht team, werken graag samen, helpen elkaar waar nodig en - het belangrijkst - we maken plezier. Zo organiseren we regelmatig verschillende activiteiten, uitjes en borrels. Maar ook op kantoor hebben we de grootste lol. De uitspraak ‘een dag niet gelachen, is een dag niet geleefd’ gaat bij ons zeker op.

Young Group heeft een no-nonsense mentaliteit en een positieve werksfeer. We willen samen plezierig werken, kennis delen, leren van onze fouten en successen vieren. Onze organisatiestructuur is dan ook horizontaal en kent dus korte (management)lijnen. Hierdoor is veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en groei. We streven naar ontwikkeling en verbetering op zowel professioneel als persoonlijk niveau en zetten individuele opleidingsbudgetten in om blijvend te kunnen leren en ontwikkelen.

Uiteraard hebben we onze zaken op orde. We voorzien je van een leuke werkplek en goede hulpmiddelen (o.a. laptop en telefoon) om fijn en gezond te werken. Je ontvangt naast een passende salaris ook nog een winstverdelingsregeling en wij doen een bijdrage (50%) in jouw pensioenopbouw. Deels thuiswerken behoort uiteraard ook tot de mogelijkheden.

Solliciteer direct!
Herken jij je in bovenstaande beschrijving en ben je enthousiast geraakt? Reageer dan snel met jouw CV én motivatiebrief in het Nederlands. Wij kijken uit naar jouw sollicitatie!

De aanvraag van een VOG is een verplicht onderdeel van het sollicitatieproces. Zonder geldige VOG is werken bij Young Group niet mogelijk.

title: Intern Analog Engineer
description:
Renesas is seeking a brilliant and motivated MSc student in Electronic Engineering for an internship to develop his/her final graduation thesis. The internship has a duration of six months to be spent in the new Renesas design center located in Catania, Italy. Objective of the internship is to perform research and development in analog and mixed-signal circuit design with a special focus on Power Management ICs and Smart Power Stages for High-Performance Computing. During the internship, the candidate will join the Performance Computing Power team in Catania working side by side with experienced engineers that will provide guidance and support throughout any technical challenge.

Responsibilities

  • Perform transistor-level design of analog and mixed-signal circuit blocks
  • Evaluate performance tradeoffs among different circuit topologies
  • Document simulation results and conduct technical reviews
  • Ensure design quality and compliance with specifications

Requirements and Skills

  • Knowledge of CMOS and bipolar transistors, diodes, resistors, capacitors, inductors
  • Basic knowledge of BCD technology
  • Ability to design basic circuit blocks, run process/voltage/temperature (PVT) corners and Montecarlo simulations
  • Knowledge of voltage and current references, current mirrors, amplifiers, comparators, oscillators & clocking circuits, digital gates
  • Knowledge of feedback control systems
  • Familiarity with switch-mode power conversion topologies and linear regulators
  • Familiarity with Cadence design environment is a plus
  • Good communication skills
  • Good knowledge of written and spoken English

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, To Make Our Lives Easier. description:
Our Mission: Why Lighthouse?

At Lighthouse, we’re on a mission to revolutionize commercial strategy as hospitality’s most powerful AI platform. We take the world's largest hotel data network and transform it into real-time intelligence that drives action. We don't just deliver insights; we empower businesses to make decisions that move revenue.

With $370M in Series C funding and over $100M in ARR, we are scaling at lightspeed. Our 850+ teammates across 35 countries aren't just building software—they are leveraging cutting-edge AI to help hoteliers be the first to act. Tens of thousands of hotels across 185 countries trust Lighthouse to execute their commercial strategy, including every one of the top 15 global chains and thousands of independent hotels that consistently outperform their markets. With Lighthouse AI, the intelligence gets deeper. Decisions get smarter. Actions get faster. We help hoteliers be first to act.

Lighthouse Values: Our guiding light

We are Lumineers. Our shared values keep us on a collaborative path fostering a cultural and customer centric environment

  • Pursuit of greatness: We’re innovators who care deeply about our customers’ success. Our team brings their best work, stays curious, and delivers excellence through attention to detail
  • Meaningful work matters: We make every moment count by knowing what to deliver, why it matters, and how it drives Lighthouse forward
  • Elevate each other: We don’t just work together - we grow together. What unites us is understanding each other as people and working toward shared goals

We’re more than just a workplace – we’re a community. Collaborative, fun, and deeply committed, we work hard together to revolutionize the hospitality sector. Are you ready to join us and shine brighter in the industry’s most exciting rocket-ship?

Job details
  • Engineering
  • Spain
  • Full-Time/Remote
What you will do

As a Data Engineering Manager, you will lead an engineering team that owns end-to-end a set of data domains within our large-scale ingestion and transformation engine, unifying the world's hospitality data into a strategic high-fidelity semantic layer. Your team builds and maintains complex data pipelines handling large data streams. This is a high-impact role where you will see your team's work directly translate into real-world applications that impact hotels worldwide. The role requires you to combine strong technical experience with operational and people management excellence.

Where you will have impact
  • Lead, coach, and mentor a team of data engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and long-term career growth.
  • Be the technical guide the team can lean on for growing their technical careers and for collaborating on their technical work, while at the same time being strong with people, organization, structure, planning and driving delivery.
  • Drive the architecture, design, implementation, maintenance, improvements and scaling of the streaming and batch data pipelines that ingest and transform the massive volume of data powering our products.
  • You are at the forefront of AI evolution, helping to embed intelligence into our organization, way of working and platform. You\'ll champion an AI-first development culture within the engineering team.
  • Identify, estimate, plan and deliver continuous improvements with the team in data quality, system stability, observability, data pipeline performance, latency, and reliability.
  • Collaborate closely with product, other engineering teams, support and business teams.
About our team

You\'ll be leading a skilled team of data engineers who own a number of data domains and integration types that feed our platform. You are responsible end-to-end for the ingestion and complex transformations for these domains, that turn massive streams of structured and less structured data into data products with actionable insights for the hospitality industry.

What's in it for you?
  • Flexible time off: Autonomy to manage your work-life balance.
  • Alan Flex benefits: 160€/month for food or nursery.
  • Flexible retribution: Optional benefits through tax-free payroll deductions for food, transportation and/or nursery.
  • Wellbeing support: Subsidized ClassPass subscription.
  • Comprehensive health insurance: 100% Alan coverage for you, your spouse, and dependents.
  • Impactful work: Shape products relied on 85,000+ users worldwide.
  • Referral bonuses: Earn rewards for bringing in new talent.
Who you are
  • You are an experienced people leader with a track record of managing engineering teams, with a passion for coaching and mentoring engineers and driving their technical and professional growth.
  • You come from a strong hands-on background in data engineering, with deep experience in ETL/ELT, batch and streaming pipelines, complex data transformations, and data modelling.
  • You have a proactive, \"can-do\" attitude, viewing challenges as opportunities and inspiring a positive, solution-oriented mindset within your team.
  • You excel at seeing the bigger picture, breaking down large architectural projects into clear, manageable tasks, and accurately estimating effort.
  • You are a forward-thinking builder who views AI as a core component of modern architecture. You have a proven interest (or experience) in working with LLMs, agentic workflows, or AI-assisted coding tools to ship higher-quality code, faster.
  • You get energized from optimizing technical architectures, structure, tooling, support and other processes.
  • Professional proficiency in Python for large-scale data processing and pipeline development.
  • Strong knowledge of data cloud technologies, data streaming systems (like Google Cloud Pub/Sub or Kafka), and cloud database solutions (like BigQuery, Spanner, Snowflake, or Databricks).
  • Fluency in English, with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
We welcome
  • Experience building integrations with third-party APIs and external data sources.
  • Experience within the hospitality technology sector or similar industries (e.g. airline industry).
Technologies you will work with

Python, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), BigQuery, Spanner, Pub/Sub, Kubernetes.

Diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Thank you for considering a career with Lighthouse. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace that values equal opportunity for all. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds, regardless of age, gender, race, religion, sexual orientation, and disability. Our commitment to equality is part of our culture. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point during the application or interview process, please notify your recruiter.
